Title: Resource Manager, Professional Services Business Unit: Graphic Communications

Department: Customer & Professional Services

Location: Brazil, Remote

About Us

Graphic Communications, a CAI Division, is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for the print industy.

Graphic Communications' integrated and automated offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies.

With over thirty years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the packaging and printing industries, it is the company's deeply held philosophy that they succeed when its customers thrive.

Position Overview

The Resource Manager plays a critical role in ensuring Professional Services teams are properly staffed, aligned, and equipped to meet project timelines and business objectives.

This role involves close collaboration with Project Managers, Project Coordinators, Regional Managers, the Sr.

Director of Professional Services, Customer Success, and Sales to efficiently manage resources, balance workloads, and ensure smooth project delivery.

Core Responsibilities

Resource Planning and Allocation

Identify, assign, and allocate resources to ongoing and upcoming projects based on skills, availability, and priorities.

Maintain a real-time view of resource capacity and project needs across the organization.

Serve as the primary point of contact for project staffing and collaborate with Sales and Regional Managers to ensure proper coverage for upcoming engagements.

Own all new engagements at intake and assign resources based on availability and skillset.

Check in regularly with Project Managers to confirm they have the resources required for project success.

Maintain up-to-date skills and certifications records for all consultants.

Forecasting and Talent Management

Collaborate with Sales, Project Managers, Regional Managers, and leadership to forecast future resource requirements.

Identify resource gaps and recommend cross-training, recruitment, or subcontracting needs based on upcoming opportunities.

Support long-term workforce planning and professional development of consultants.

Process Optimization and Tool Management

Develop and maintain tools, dashboards, and reports to monitor utilization, productivity, and performance.

Establish and enforce consistent processes for resource requests and assignments to maximize efficiency.

Ensure data and processes remain aligned across systems.

Daily Operational Responsibilities

New Engagement Intake

Review new projects pushed from Salesforce into Wrike.

Confirm all project metadata: customer, region, product, estimated hours, and key contacts.

Confirm the correct Wrike template and folder structure were created.

If automation fails, manually create projects using Salesforce data.

Assignment & Scheduling

Review unassigned Wrike projects daily.

Match consultants to projects based on skill set, availability, and regional needs.

Assign both primary and secondary consultants and confirm schedules with stakeholders.

Flag any assignment conflicts or delays to Regional Managers or Services Leads.

System Sync and Integration Oversight

Cross-reference Salesforce ? Wrike and Wrike ? NetSuite mappings to ensure accuracy.

Validate billing fields (sold-to ID, billing trigger, engagement type) and confirm correct syncing.

Ensure Concur sync processes are updating users, vendors, and expenses accurately.

Monitor Wrike integration logs and escalate issues as needed.

Maintain field mapping and oversee sync processes across Salesforce, NetSuite, and Concur.

Track and resolve open integration issues in collaboration with Operations.

Time Tracking Oversight

Validate daily timesheet entries for all consultants.

Identify missing, misallocated, or excessive time entries and follow up as needed.

Escalate persistent noncompliance to Regional Managers.

Ensure adherence to time entry policies for accurate utilization and billing reporting.

Project Health & Status Monitoring

Monitor project dashboards in Wrike for task completion, budget consumption, and forecasted effort.

Reporting & Communication

Participate in regular syncs with Regional Managers.

Track upcoming projects, resourcing constraints, and urgent escalations.

Respond to inquiries regarding capacity, project swaps, or timeline adjustments.

Provide data for utilization, staffing, revenue forecasting, and any other Professional Services metrics.

Performance and Collaboration

Monitor workload balance across consultants.

Participate in resource reviews with Regional Managers to support continuous development based on Sales forecast.

Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Professional Services teams to align timelines, priorities, and dependencies.

Qualifications

Experience:

4+ years of experience in resource planning or operations within a software or technology organization.

Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and balance resources effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Skills

Strong proficiency with resource planning tools (e.g., Wrike)

Working Knowledge Of JIRA, Salesforce, Required, And NetSuite Preferred.

Excellent organizational, communication, and negotiation skills.

Work Authorization

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States.

Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination

title: Especialista Funcional De Engenharia De Software(Negócio)
description:
Job description

Nossa área é o centro estratégico que conecta a estratégia comercial com a execução de vendas. Atendemos todas as verticais da Porto, potencializando a atuação da Diretoria Comercial, incluindo gestores, a força de vendas e nossa rede de corretores.

Somos responsáveis por entregar excelência tecnológica e operacional nas frentes cruciais para o nosso sucesso em vendas:

  • Canais e Canais Diferenciados: Otimizando as plataformas e jornadas de distribuição.
  • Produção Comercial: Assegurando a eficiência e a inteligência do fluxo de vendas.
  • Comissões: Garantindo transparência e agilidade na remuneração.

Somos a ponte entre a ambição comercial e a inovação que a realiza.

Main responsibilities
  • Consultoria e Facilitação : Preparar e conduzir reuniões com stakeholders (definição de pauta, apresentações e atas), além de workshops e treinamentos para usuários.
  • Resolução de Problemas: Aplicar técnicas de Discovery e ideação, como Mapas Mentais, Lean Inception e Design Thinking para estruturar soluções complexas.
  • Mapeamento Agnóstico de Processos: Levantar, desenhar e otimizar processos de ponta a ponta (AS-IS e TO-BE), independentemente da plataforma onde serão implementados.
  • Prototipação e Demonstração: Criar mocks (dinâmicos e estáticos) e realizar demonstrações práticas.
  • Documentação Técnica e Funcional: Elaborar especificações detalhadas, incluindo diagramas, premissas, itens fora de escopo e forma de atendimento dos requisitos.
  • Documentação Funcional Robusta: Elaborar especificações funcionais, casos de uso, histórias de usuário e critérios de aceite que sirvam de guia claro para desenvolvedores de diferentes stacks.
  • Gestão de Requisitos Multidisciplinar: Atuar como ponte entre stakeholders de negócio e squads técnicas diversas. Você precisará explicar a mesma regra de negócio tanto para um dev Java quanto para um consultor Dynamics.
  • Facilitação e Discovery: Conduzir workshops, Lean Inceptions, Design Thinking e reuniões de pauta para desvendar problemas complexos antes de iniciar o desenvolvimento.
  • Qualidade e Testes: Elaborar e executar planos de testes integrados (SIT) e apoiar os usuários chave na execução dos testes de aceite (UAT).
  • Mentoria: Atuar com autonomia e servir como referência técnica/funcional, validando as entregas e apoiando o desenvolvimento de analistas mais juniores.
Requirements and skills
  • Experiência comprovada em documentação de requisitos, modelagem de processos (BPMN) e metodologias de desenvolvimento (Ágil/Scrum é um diferencial).
  • Superior completo em Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Administração ou áreas correlativas.
  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação e negociação para interagir com diferentes stakeholders (da liderança de negócio ao time técnico).
  • Diferenciais: Certificações em Análise de Negócios (CBAP, PMI-PBA) ou em metodologias Ágeis.
  • Sólida experiência como Analista de Negócios, Analista de Sistemas ou Especialista Funcional, preferencialmente atuando em projetos de implementação/evolução de jornadas comerciais com tecnologias Microsoft, Java, Informix 4GL.
  • Frameworks: Experiência em atuação em projetos que utilizam frameworks Ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e Tradicionais (Cascata), sabendo quando aplicar cada abordagem.
  • Gestão de Projetos: Conhecimento e experiência no gerenciamento de planos de ação, mapeamento de processos e gestão de atividades.
  • Modelagem de Processos: Proficiência na modelagem de processos de negócio, utilizando ferramentas como Bizagi e Drawio ou similares.
  • Ferramentas de Apoio: Habilidade na utilização de ferramentas de apoio e debug, como XRMToolBox, Postman, Fiddler, ou outras específicas para o seu contexto de sistemas (Ex: ferramentas para ERP ou CRM).

  • Serviços de Transporte: Para o seu conforto e segurança no trajeto até o nosso escritório, disponibilizamos vans nas principais estações de acesso à Porto: Luz, Barra Funda, Santa Cecília e Júlio Prestes;

  • Participação nos Lucros - PLR: Pois sabemos que só vamos crescer, se crescermos juntos;
  • Porto em Ação: Programa complementar à PLR, disponibilizando anualmente, até 2025, uma porcentagem de valor do seu salário em ações da Porto;
  • Pais, mães e filhos: Auxílio creche ou babá, para cuidar do seu bem mais precioso;
  • Previdência Privada - PortoPrev: Para você garantir um futuro mais tranquilo;
  • Wellhub: Para você possa se exercitar e cuidar da sua saúde física em diversas academias, onde estiver;
  • Bolsa de estudos: Para você começar uma graduação ou que sonha em fazer uma segunda faculdade ou pós-graduação.

title: Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing
description:
Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part‑Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing

Join to apply for the Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part‑Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing role at Go! Running Tours

Hi…
My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours.
Running Tours.
This is not your usual job post.
Instead of writing a fast‑paced, bullet‑pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours.
Maybe no one will reply.
Maybe many will.
I just need one really good one!
So let's start. Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients.
Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services. Your marketing DNA has to be of the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B.
I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground. We are lucky that sometimes amazing opportunities (that - if you are a runner and marketeer - probably will make you do cartwheels) land in our turban.

You'll be working on a newsletter and pling!

  • an email lands in your inbox from Brooks, or Lululemon, or Abbott World Marathon Majors.
Whoop whoop!
Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time.
Not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà: now you nailed it!

Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world!
We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed ) and in the future, with your help, many more...right? I am looking for someone in constant growth mode.
Growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business.
Growth in terms of testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations.
Growth in terms of taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things, and current trends. Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground.
We already send regular newsletters that do well, BUT someone with a data/automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously.
And have loads of fun with it.

I personally love testing new ideas, so know that you'll have me and colleagues from all over the world cheering you on every step of the way. You'll also own our digital advertising efforts.
That means planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle.
We don't throw spaghetti at the wall here: we test, learn, and scale what works.
You’ll also get to create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations.
If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we'll back you while you do).

You will be working directly with me in the role.
I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that "makes sense" to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive.
I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners!
Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, I focus radically on progress, and I dislike sloppiness (with a passion).
Most people, I believe (or at least hope), also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting, and understanding (admittedly still very little understanding for sloppiness ;-)).
My guess is that if you are good at what you do and eager to excel in this role, we will end up best buddies!

We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week.
All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done.
There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you're never left alone in any way.
We're just on the other side of the world.

The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with).
It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work.
The Money Should Not Be The Main Motivation For You - Running, Bridging Cultures, And Being Part Of a Fun, Fast-moving, And Positive Company Should. The Contract Details Are As Follows

USD 1,400 a month
25 hrs a week
Managed via Upwork
Oh, and hey... if you're considering this role as an add-on to an already existing full-time job, then hold your horses .
I don't believe in my colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn't align with our company values.
We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it.
The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow... the business and yourself.
But the most important skill of all is: execution.
If we don't execute, we can't move the needle. That's it, I think.

I've probably left out loads of super important things, but at least this gives you some idea. If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me with a short spiel on why you feel you're right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours.
Running Tours (no AI please - we want to know the real you, not the ChatGPT version ).
Thanks for reading this far.

Note: we usually take down our job posts within 3-4 days as we receive many applicants.

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its App of the Day.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast-paced environments, passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week.

Overview

As Speechify expands, our AI team seeks a Senior Backend Engineer. This role is central to ensuring our infrastructure scales efficiently, optimizing key product flows, and constructing resilient end-to-end systems. If you are passionate about strategizing, enjoy high-paced environments, and are eager to take ownership of product decisions, we’d love to hear from you.

  • Low latency and cost effective text to speech

  • Direct experience with GCP and knowledge of AWS, Azure, or other cloud providers.
  • Efficiency in ideation and implementation, prioritizing tasks based on urgency and impact.
  • Experience with Docker and containerized deployments.
  • Proficiency in deploying high availability applications on Kubernetes.
  • Preferred: Experience deploying NLP or TTS models to production.

What We Offer

  • A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products.
  • A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive.
  • Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity.
  • The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry.
  • Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture.
  • The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more.
  • An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain.

Job description

Em 2017, a Companhia realizou seu primeiro investimento ao adquirir o Vera Cruz Hospital, localizado na cidade Campinas-SP, que com mais de 80 anos de atuação, é um dos mais tradicionais hospitais da cidade. O hospital atualmente conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 08 Leitos de Apoio Cirúrgico, 110 leitos de internação, 14 leitos de UTI Adulto, 10 leitos de Unidade Cardiológica, 10 leitos semi‑intensiva, 16 leitos Maternidade/Alojamento Conjunto, 09 leitos Pediatria e Pronto Socorro 24h. Além de atender mais de 66 especialidades, ter acreditação ONA 3e ter conquistado em 2025 a importantíssima acreditação da JCI.

Com a inauguração, por exemplo, de serviços novos como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia, a Unidade de Atenção Primária da Saúde e a criação das unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba.

Nesse mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos também a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2Care.

IT Risk & Resiliency Manager

Guaynabo, PR

ABOUT US

At Triple S, we are committed to provide meaningful job experiences for Valuable People (Gente Valiosa). We encourage an environment of very high ethical standards, always excelling in service, collaboration among the company, agility to deliver timely, and embracingaccountability for results.

When you join Triple S, you will be key to our efforts on delivering high-quality and affordable healthcare as well as contribute to our purpose to enable healthier lives. We serve more than 1 million consumers in Puerto Rico through our Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, Commercial, Life and Property & Casualty Businesses.

Let’s build healthier communities together, join now!

ABOUT THE ROLE

Responsible for developing, implementing, and managing the company's IT risk management framework and ensuring robust IT resiliency capabilities. This critical role involves identifying, assessing, mitigating, and monitoring technology-related risks across the enterprise. Will lead the IT Business Continuity/Disaster Recovery (BC/DR) program, manage compliance with risk policies, and drive a culture of risk awareness and operational resilience within the IT organization and across the business.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
  • Lead and manage the end-to-end IT Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery program.
  • Define and maintain the IT BC/DR strategy, ensuring alignment with organizational business impact analysis (BIA) and risk appetite.
  • Oversee the development, documentation, and maintenance of comprehensive, actionable BC and DR plans for critical IT systems and infrastructure.
  • Plan, coordinate, and execute regular, rigorous BC/DR testing and exercises (tabletop, functional, full-scale) to validate the effectiveness of recovery strategies and plans.
  • Collaborate with the Incident Response team to ensure seamless integration of recovery procedures into the overall IT incident management process.
  • Ensure IT practices and controls comply with relevant laws, regulations, and internal policies (e.g., SOX, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS).
  • Act as the primary IT liaison for internal and external audits related to IT risk, BC/DR, and controls, coordinating responses and remediation efforts.
  • Contribute to the Third-Party Risk Management program by assessing and managing the resiliency and risk posture of critical IT vendors and service providers.
  • Develop and deliver training and awareness programs to educate IT staff and business users on IT risk, security, and BC/DR best practices.
  • Conduct DR failover, failback, and restore activities, validating application and data recovery.
  • Work with IT and business stakeholders to develop and track remediation plans for identified risks, ensuring timely and effective control implementation.
  • Deliver operational dashboards and executive-level reports on RPO/RTO, backup/replication health, and recovery readiness.
  • Design, implement, and continually improve resiliency programs that prepare Triple-S to respond to business disruptions, technology outages, and crises.
  • Organize and execute company-wide risk assessments as well as business impact analyses, identifying key threats and evaluating preparedness.
  • Work closely with teams managing BC, DR, and CM teams to drive strong alignment and robust and integrated response plans.
  • Create and update dashboards, reports, and metrics that help senior leaders monitor firm resilience and mitigation progress.
  • Maintain and regularly update the enterprise risk register, tracking mitigation actions and monitoring emerging threats.
  • Drive other resiliency participants or technical staff, setting clear priorities and developing team capabilities.
  • Manage resiliency program budgets, timelines, and reporting requirements.
  • Establish metrics, dashboards, and KPIs to monitor resiliency posture and track improvement.
  • Partners with business continuity managers to align technical DR plans with business continuity priorities.
  • Collaborate with InfoSec/SecOps. Collaborate with Compliance/Risk team to assure adherence
  • Participates in joint incident response exercises
  • Provides business units with reporting on recovery capabilities, test outcomes, and risks that may impact operations.
  • Works with application owners to define application-level recovery needs
WHAT YOU'LL BRING

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent experience). 7+ years in IT resiliency, infrastructure, systems administration, or disaster recovery roles preferable in the Health Insurance Industry. 3+ years in management or technical leadership role. Experience with regulatory frameworks and risk management methodologies.

title: Data Scientist
description:
We are a global digital agency composed of strategists, creatives, media experts, data scientists, and engineers driven by one common purpose — accelerate business growth through marketing and digital transformation.

Named a top 3% Google Premier Partner and recognized by Inc.

  • Adweek's 75 Fastest Growing Companies, we're constantly looking for "A" players to join our team.

The rapid growth is attributed to our strongest asset — our people.

Our teams are highly collaborative and work closely with each client to set clear goals and objectives so that we can deliver exceptional results.

Mindgruve is a place where every opinion is valued.

Not only will you be empowered to contribute ideas, but you will also play a key role in the execution and driving success for brands across a variety of industries.

Sounds fun?

Perfect — you'll fit right in.

The Data Scientist plays a key role in delivering, maintaining, and evolving our data science solutions for clients.

This position blends hands-on analytics, applied machine learning, and software development in a fast-paced, client-facing environment.

The primary responsibility is to fit, run, maintain, and configure our suite of data science models and pipelines for clients, while also taking on ad hoc analytical projects and contributing to our shared solution code base when capacity allows.

This is a hybrid role—part data scientist as an analyst, part developer, and part researcher.

You'll work closely with internal teams and some of the world's leading brands to test, refine, and operationalize models that drive meaningful business outcomes.

When not actively engaged in client delivery, you'll contribute to our internal development efforts by improving productized data science tools, frameworks, and automation capabilities.

The role offers a unique opportunity to gain broad exposure across the full data science lifecycle—from research and experimentation to deployment, performance monitoring, and ongoing model enhancement.

It's designed for someone eager to deepen both their technical and business acumen, expand their experience across diverse use cases, and prepare for advancement into a Senior Data Scientist position.

What You’ll Do Here

Fit, run, maintain, and contribute to the build of proprietary machine learning models including :

  • Marketing and Media Mix
  • Performance Forecasting
  • Price Elasticity
  • Competitive Pricing
  • Merchandising Optimization
  • Audience Segmentation
  • Lift Studies
Collaborate with Sr.

Data Scientists, ML Operations Engineers, and Data engineers to support the build and validation of enterprise data science solutions.

Collaborate with marketing and strategy teams to understand client needs and translate them into data science problems.

Design and conduct lift studies to validate hypotheses and measure the impact of our solutions.

Create insightful visualizations to communicate findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in machine learning and data science, and propose innovative solutions to improve our offerings.

We Need a Person With

Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.

Strong proficiency in Python, with experience using common Data Science libraries such as scikit-learn, PyTorch, Pandas, NumPy, and Matplotlib.

Experience with SQL.

Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team.

Adaptability and eagerness to learn in a fast-paced environment.

Professional and personal integrity.

A detail-oriented mindset, focused on driving results.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

What We Consider a Plus

Experience with MLOps and leading machine learning algorithms like XGBoost, Neural Networks, Regression Analysis, etc.

Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, or Azure).

Experience with AWS SageMaker.

Experience working in MLOps framework and ability to contribute to the pipeline and collaborate closely with MLOps Engineers.

Experience with AI and agentic systems is a plus.

title: Associate Director of Research Administration
description:
Associate Director of Research Administration

The Associate Director of Research Administration will oversee the College Research Administrators (CRAs) and departmental research administrators, ensuring effective pre- and post-award support for faculty. This role will be responsible for the training, oversight, and performance evaluation of research administrators across all colleges. The Associate Director will serve as the primary liaison between the Office of Research (OOR) and the Associate Deans, working to improve administrative efficiency and ensure compliance with federal and institutional policies.

Benefits Here Is What We Offer
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant university culture
Supervisory Authority
  • Directly supervises CRAs and departmental research administrators, ensuring consistent and effective research administration support.
  • Works closely with Deans, Associate Deans, and PIs to monitor and enhance grant support services.
  • Develops standardized departmental processes for pre- and post-award administration to be implemented university-wide.
  • Oversees the integration of existing departmental research administrators into the new centralized structure.
Nature And Scope

Reporting directly to the Director of Research Administration/AVP of Research Operations, the Associate Director will implement a centralized research administration model. This role will establish standardized workflows, ensure research administrators receive ongoing training, and work closely with Associate Deans and faculty to troubleshoot issues. The Associate Director will also lead monthly research administration meetings to facilitate training, updates, and process improvements.

Principal Accountabilities Oversight & Management
  • Directly supervises CRAs and departmental research administrators, ensuring consistent and effective research administration support.
  • Works closely with Deans, Associate Deans, and PIs to monitor and enhance grant support services.
  • Develops standardized departmental processes for pre- and post-award administration to be implemented university-wide.
  • Oversees the integration of existing departmental research administrators into the new centralized structure.
Training & Professional Development
  • Develops and implements an onboarding program for newly hired and transitioning research administrators.
  • Ensures that all research administrators complete 12 hours of required training annually, covering:
  • Proposal development & sponsor guidelines
  • Budgeting & financial management
  • Workday grants system workflows
  • Federal compliance & university policies
Leads monthly 3‑hour research administration meetings, providing updates, training, and addressing concerns raised by administrators and faculty. Performance Management & Feedback
  • Works with Associate Deans to evaluate CRA and departmental research administrator performance.
  • Develops and implements performance metrics for tracking research administration effectiveness across colleges.
  • Addresses faculty concerns regarding research administration support and identifies opportunities for process improvement.
Collaboration & Troubleshooting
  • Serves as the primary liaison between CRAs, departmental administrators, Associate Deans, Sponsored Programs Office (SPO), and Research Operations.
  • Identifies and resolves issues related to grant setup, payments, budgeting, and compliance.
  • Works with HR and Procurement to streamline grant‑related hiring and financial workflows.
Compliance & Policy Implementation
  • Ensures research administrators stay current with federal, state, and institutional policies affecting sponsored programs.
  • Provides updates and guidance on changes in grant regulations (e.g., NIH, NSF, DoE, 2 CFR 200).
  • Monitors research administration practices to ensure adherence to university and federal compliance requirements.
Core Competencies
  • Strong leadership skills in managing teams across multiple colleges.
  • Expertise in pre‑ and post‑award research administration within a university setting.
  • Advanced knowledge of federal grant regulations and institutional compliance policies.
  • Effective problem‑solving and the ability to streamline complex administrative workflows.
  • Excellent communication and training skills to support administrators and faculty.
  • Strong collaborative mindset with experience working across multiple stakeholders (faculty, deans, HR, finance, research operations).
Minimum Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, research administration, public administration, finance, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 7 years of research administration experience, with pre‑ and post‑award management expertise.
  • Familiarity with federal funding agency policies (e.g., NIH, NSF, DoE, DOD grants & contracts).
  • Experience in supervising and training research administrators.
  • Strong knowledge of Workday Grants (or similar ERP), federal grant compliance, and university‑sponsored programs administration.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead teams and manage process improvements.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Certified Research Administrator (CRA) or Certified Pre‑Award Research Administrator (CPRA) certification.
  • Experience working in an R1 university or large research‑intensive institution.

title: Technical Product Manager Pleno
description:
Sobre a Gente

Aqui na Mottu acreditamos que nossa operação e tecnologia andam lado a lado. Acreditamos que para entregar valor à operação, Tech e Produto devem andar juntos, assumindo papel protagonista, desenvolvendo soluções que resolvem problemas reais do dia a dia. Nessa realidade, cada líder precisa inspirar seu time nesses dois mundos, sendo responsável por :

  • Discutir roadmap e priorizar backlog junto aos stakeholders
  • Implementar e entregar com tecnologia de ponta aquilo que foi definido
  • Acompanhar e monitorar os principais indicadores para validar o sucesso da iniciativa e, a partir de dados, tomar decisões

Como um Technical Product Manager (TPM), você será responsável por conduzir o desenvolvimento do produto e de tecnologia alinhado com a estratégia da empresa, construir e gerenciar produtos para os nossos clientes visando o crescimento, estabilidade e experiência do cliente. Esperamos que você seja o canal de união em produto, dados, tecnologia, business e estratégia do produto que você está tocando, e que seja um "mini-CEO" naquela equipe, concentrando a responsabilidade pelas decisões feitas.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

Construir e executar a visão estratégica do produto sob sua responsabilidade;

Estar na "ponta da lança", vivendo o dia a dia da sua área para ter profundidade e entendimento dos sistemas / processos;

Gerenciar o desenvolvimento de sistemas complexos, inovadores, e ao mesmo tempo simples, de alta escalabilidade com decisões de arquitetura sólidas para garantir reaproveitamento de código e facilitar o desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades em tempo hábil;

Desenvolver a estratégia do time de engenharia, definindo objetivos e entregáveis de valor que vão gerar autonomia e produtividade para os times de tecnologia;

Realizar benchmarking trazendo insights e tendências do mercado que apoiarão no entendimento e evolução do produto;

Operar em um ambiente dinâmico, com autonomia e ser capaz de influenciar os demais times;

Demonstrar habilidades sólidas de liderança, organização e execução para conduzir projetos de desenvolvimento de produtos desde o conceito até o lançamento;

Coletar e refinar requisitos do negócio (equipes internas de produtos, engenheiros, equipes de negócios, marketing, finanças, etc.) através não só de conversas, mas também de muita mão na massa;

Criar e gerenciar o roadmap do produto;

Colaborar com equipes de engenheiros e designers para definir os requisitos do produto e garantir sua viabilidade técnica;

Acompanhar o ciclo de vida do produto, desde o planejamento até o lançamento, garantindo qualidade e product market fit;

Monitorar e analisar métricas e indicadores de desempenho do produto para avaliar seu sucesso e identificar oportunidades de melhoria.

Requisitos e Qualificações

Experiência com +3 anos de em gerenciamento de produtos e / ou gerenciamento de tecnologia (eng. manager);

Experiência comprovada em tecnologia / desenvolvimento (Parte da sua jornada ter sido como desenvolvedor);

Disponibilidade para trabalhar presencialmente na região da Vila Leopoldina;

Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis de desenvolvimento de produtos;

Conhecimento em ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, etc.);

Conhecimento em bancos de dados PostgreSQL e / ou MongoDB;

Conhecimento em análise de dados (SQL, PowerBI etc.);

Pensamento, atitude e resultado de dono do produto;

Orientação para resultados, pensamento analítico e habilidades de resolução de problemas;

Habilidade de comunicação para conversar com clientes internos, externos e trazer os pontos relevantes para o time de engenharia;

Capacidade de tomar decisões baseadas em dados e priorizar tarefas de acordo com os objetivos estratégicos;

Capacidade de liderança, recrutamento de pessoas e gerenciamento do time sob sua responsabilidade;

Conhecimentos desejáveis em OpenAPI (Swagger), Postman, Jira, Git, GitFlow, Cloud Environments (Azure, GCP e outros);

Diferenciais
  • Vivência em ambientes de startup;
  • Conhecimento em .NET / C#, NodeJS, Python ou Angular;
  • Conhecimento de técnicas de benchmarking e entrevistas de clientes;
O que não combina com a gente

1. Resistência ao ritmo acelerado e à pressão

A Mottu tem uma cultura de alta performance , com foco em velocidade, entrega e resultado. O ambiente é intenso e muda rápido.

Quem não tem resiliência ou precisa de acompanhamento constante tende a ter dificuldade.

Aqui, não há espaço para zona de conforto ou microgestão.

2. ️ Falta de proatividade e aversão à “mão na graxa”

Valorizamos quem vai até a raiz do problema, entra na operação e resolve .

Esperar que outros tomem a frente, evitar tarefas operacionais ou depender de supervisão constante não combina com nossa cultura.

Quem não coloca a mão na massa dificilmente entende o que precisa ser melhorado — e não evolui aqui.

E quando falamos de “mão na graxa”, é literal : vamos para a oficina, atuamos com o time e executamos funções operacionais .

Essa vivência prática traz insights que seriam impossíveis à distância.

3. Baixo espírito de dono e pouca autonomia

Esperamos atitude de dono : coragem para decidir, assumir riscos e gerar impacto real.

Quem espera ser “mandado” ou depende de validação constante tende a ficar para trás.

Aqui, protagonismo não é opcional — é parte do trabalho.

E diferente de muitas empresas, levamos isso a sério : quem entrega com consistência e atitude é reconhecido, recebe espaço e pode até se tornar sócio.

Stock options não são exceção — são consequência.

4. Falta de abertura para feedback e pouca maturidade emocional

Somos uma cultura de transparência direta . Feedbacks são frequentes, sinceros — e nem sempre suaves.

É preciso humildade e maturidade para encarar conversas difíceis, sem ego ou melindres.

Quem evita confronto construtivo ou não aceita críticas com boa intenção pode se sentir deslocado.

5. ⏰ Apego rígido ao horário comercial

A Mottu ainda é uma startup em crescimento acelerado . Os desafios mudam rápido, e as demandas nem sempre respeitam o relógio.

Não há certo ou errado — o que importa é resolver o problema .

Se você busca rotina estável e separação rígida entre vida pessoal e trabalho, pode se frustrar aqui.

Entregar com qualidade é o foco — e isso nem sempre cabe dentro do horário comercial.

6. Falta de comprometimento e troca frequente de trabalho

Aqui, não buscamos apenas talento — buscamos gente que queira construir junto .

Se a cada desafio ou obstáculo a primeira reação é procurar a próxima oportunidade, dificilmente haverá tempo para gerar impacto real.

A Mottu é feita para quem tem visão de longo prazo , veste a camisa e está disposto a atravessar ciclos inteiros de crescimento, mostrar seu espaço e se tornar sócio.

Quem não se compromete, não colhe os frutos — e aqui, eles são grandes para quem fica e faz acontecer.

Se você se identifica com esse ritmo, essa cultura e quer fazer parte de um time que realmente constrói tecnologia de impacto : vem com a gente.

title: Machine Learning Engineer Sênior/Especialista
description:
Join to apply for the Machine Learning Engineer Sênior/Especialista role at Ideen

Estamos em busca de um(a) Machine Learning Engineer para atuar em um cliente do setor financeiro que está acelerando sua jornada em dados e inteligência artificial. Você será responsável por desenhar, treinar, avaliar e colocar em produção modelos de Machine Learning e Deep Learning, trabalhando com grandes volumes de dados, problemas complexos de negócio (risco, crédito, fraude, comportamento, operações) e, cada vez mais, com LLMs e técnicas modernas como RAG e modelos foundation. Esperamos alguém com rigor técnico, visão analítica e capacidade de transformar dados em decisões concretas, conectando pesquisa aplicada, engenharia de software e impacto real no negócio.

O que esperamos de você
  • Experiência sólida com Python, bibliotecas de ciência de dados e ML (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow ou similares).
  • Vivência com modelagem estatística, ML supervisionado e não supervisionado, DL e avaliação de modelos.
  • Conhecimento de bancos de dados e SQL, incluindo otimização de consultas e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Experiência em tratamento e análise de dados complexos (datasets grandes, ruidosos ou de alta dimensionalidade).
  • Noções de LLMs e GenAI (uso de APIs, fine‑tuning, RAG, embeddings, avaliação de saídas).
  • Capacidade de formular hipóteses, desenhar experimentos e interpretar resultados com pensamento crítico.
  • Familiaridade com ambientes em cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure) aplicados a dados e ML.
  • Inglês avançado para leitura, escrita técnica e eventual interação com stakeholders globais.
Tarefas
  • Desenvolver e evoluir modelos de Machine Learning e Deep Learning para casos de uso como: previsão e modelagem de risco, churn, fraude, inadimplência; segmentação e clustering de clientes e comportamentos; classificação, ranking e recomendação.
  • Trabalhar com LLMs e GenAI em cenários que exijam RAG, sumarização, classificação de texto, análise de documentos e assistentes internos.
  • Estruturar pipelines de dados e de treinamento, desde preparação e feature engineering até deployment em produção.
  • Implementar rotinas de avaliação, monitoramento e re‑treino de modelos (drift, performance, acurácia, fairness).
  • Colaborar com times de dados, produto, engenharia e negócio para entender problemas, formatar hipóteses e validar soluções.
  • Documentar metodologias, experimentos, resultados e decisões de modelagem de forma clara e auditável.
  • Atuar na melhoria contínua de qualidade de dados: consistência, limpeza, enriquecimento e governança.
  • Apoiar a definição e implementação de boas práticas de MLOps em parceria com engenharia e plataforma.
Formação

Superior Completo: Formação em instituições de referência (USP, Unicamp, ITA, UFRJ, CBPF, INPE, IME, Poli, UFMG, Insper, etc.) - não é impeditivo ter a graduação em outras instituições.

title: Channel Partner Director
description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in 11 countries, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are seeking a Channel Partner Director to join our Wellz Commercial Team, a senior professional who is passionate about building lasting, high-impact relationships and eager to contribute to a team driven by mutual growth and continuous innovation.

As Channel Partner Director, you will be responsible to optimize the performance of indirect sales channels within the Brokers, Insurance, Benefits and Health Tech segments . This role requires a seasoned leader with expertise in defining, executing, and optimizing the strategy for our Partner Ecosystem. Beyond relationship management, you will be responsible for developing, and scaling indirect channels, ensuring both operational efficiency and long-term scalability. The ideal candidate is a skilled communicator who can seamlessly engage with stakeholders at all levels—from sales teams to C-levels.

Are you ready to take on this challenge and make a difference?

YOUR IMPACT
  • Expansion: Expand indirect channel ecosystem, establishing new partnerships and increasing the generation of new opportunities within existing partners.
  • Sales: Assist channel partners’ sales teams in crafting winning strategies, preparing compelling business proposals, and addressing technical inquiries to close deals. Participate in meetings and negotiations with end customers alongside channel partners.
  • Customer Relationship Management: build strong relationships with partners and ensure satisfaction, including frequent in-person meetings as a strategy
  • Value Proposition: Identify and tailor the best value proposition for each partner segment. Design and manage incentive programs, tiered partnerships, and co-marketing initiatives to drive partner loyalty and engagement.
  • Training and Empowerment: Provide ongoing training to channel partner representatives, ensuring they are well-versed in Wellz’s services, and sales strategies.
  • Performance Monitoring and Feedback: Analyze channel partner performance, track key metrics, and deliver actionable insights to optimize results.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.
WHO YOU ARE
  • Proven and extensive experience in managing and expanding indirect channels with multiple segments and stakeholders.
  • Expertise in process creation and channel structuring, focused on establishing a solid operational foundation for scalability and growth.
  • Strong proficiency in business case development, including identifying, creating, and justifying strategic commercial opportunities.
  • Results-driven professional with advanced skills in negotiation and successfully closing complex deals.
  • Experienced in relationship management, including mapping, engaging, and maintaining strategic stakeholders.
  • Proven experience managing and mentoring high-performing teams.
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to translate corporate objectives into tactical and long-term action plans.
  • Deep knowledge of channel performance analysis, ensuring continuous monitoring and identification of improvement opportunities.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in channel management and indirect sales within Brokers and Insurance are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

  • WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.
  • WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.
  • HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.
  • FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

title: Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing
description:
Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing

Join to apply for the Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing role at Go! Running Tours

1 week ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Hi… My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours. This is not your usual job post. Instead of writing a fast‑paced, bullet‑pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours. Maybe no one will reply. Maybe many will. I just need one really good one! So let’s start. Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients.

Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services. Your marketing DNA has to be of the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B. I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground. We are lucky that sometimes amazing opportunities (that - if you are a runner and marketeer - probably will make you do cartwheels) land in our turban. You'll be working on a newsletter and pling! An email lands in your inbox from Brooks, or Lululemon, or Abbott World Marathon Majors. Whoop whoop!

Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time. Not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà: now you nailed it!

Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world! We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed) and in the future, with your help, many more… right?

I am looking for someone in constant growth mode.

  • Growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business.
  • Growth in terms of testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations.
  • Growth in terms of taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things, and current trends.

Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground. We already send regular newsletters that do well, but someone with a data/automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously. And have loads of fun with it.

I personally love testing new ideas, so know that you'll have me and colleagues from all over the world cheering you on every step of the way. You’ll also own our digital advertising efforts. That means planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle.

We don’t throw spaghetti at the wall here: we test, learn, and scale what works. You’ll also get to create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations. If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we’ll back you while you do).

You will be working directly with me in the role.

I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that “makes sense” to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive. I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners! Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, I focus radically on progress, and I dislike sloppiness (with a passion). Most people, I believe (or at least hope), also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting, and understanding (admittedly still very little understanding for sloppiness ;-)). My guess is that if you are good at what you do and eager to excel in this role, we will end up best buddies!

We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you're never left alone in any way. We’re just on the other side of the world.

The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The Money Should Not Be The Main Motivation For You – Running, Bridging Cultures, And Being Part Of a Fun, Fast‑moving, And Positive Company Should. The Contract Details Are As Follows:

USD 1,400 a month
25 hrs a week
Managed via Upwork

Oh, and hey... if you're considering this role as an add‑on to an already existing full‑time job, then hold your horses. I don't believe in my colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn't align with our company values. We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it.

The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow… the business and yourself. But the most important skill of all is: execution. If we don't execute, we can't move the needle. That's it, I think.

I've probably left out loads of super important things, but at least this gives you some idea. If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me ****** with a short spiel on why you feel you're right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours (no AI please - we want to know the real you, not the ChatGPT version ). Thanks for reading this far, Lena

Note: we usually take down our job posts within 3‑4 days as we receive many applicants.

CAI Software, LLC

Department: Customer & Professional Services

About us

Graphic Communications, a CAI Division, is a leading global provider of industry‑specific business and production software technology for the print industry. Graphic Communications' integrated and automated offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With over thirty years dedicated to delivering best‑in‑class technology to the packaging and printing industries, it is the company's deeply held philosophy that they succeed when its customers thrive.

Position Overview

The Resource Manager plays a critical role in ensuring Professional Services teams are properly staffed, aligned, and equipped to meet project timelines and business objectives. This role involves close collaboration with Project Managers, Project Coordinators, Regional Managers, Sr. Director of Professional Services, Customer Success, and Sales to efficiently manage resources, balance workloads, and ensure smooth project delivery.

Core Responsibilities
  • Resource Planning and Allocation: Identify, assign, and allocate resources to ongoing and upcoming projects based on skills, availability, and priorities. Maintain a real‑time view of resource capacity and project needs across the organization. Serve as the primary point of contact for project staffing and collaborate with Sales and Regional Managers to ensure proper coverage for upcoming engagements. Own all new engagements at intake and assign resources based on availability and skillset. Check in regularly with Project Managers to confirm they have the resources required for project success. Maintain up‑to‑date skills and certifications records for all consultants.
  • Forecasting and Talent Management: Collaborate with Sales, Project Managers, Regional Managers, and leadership to forecast future resource requirements. Identify resource gaps and recommend cross‑training, recruitment, or subcontracting needs based on upcoming opportunities. Support long‑term workforce planning and professional development of consultants.
  • Process Optimization and Tool Management: Develop and maintain tools, dashboards, and reports to monitor utilization, productivity, and performance. Establish and enforce consistent processes for resource requests and assignments to maximize efficiency. Ensure data and processes remain aligned across systems.
  • Daily Operational Responsibilities:
    • New Engagement Intake: Review new projects pushed from Salesforce into Wrike. Confirm all project metadata: customer, region, product, estimated hours, and key contacts. Confirm the correct Wrike template and folder structure were created. If automation fails, manually create projects using Salesforce data.
    • Assignment & Scheduling: Review unassigned Wrike projects daily; match consultants to projects based on skill set, availability, and regional needs; assign both primary and secondary consultants and confirm schedules with stakeholders; flag assignment conflicts or delays to Regional Managers or Services Leads.
    • System Sync and Integration Oversight: Cross‑reference Salesforce ↔ Wrike ↔ NetSuite mappings; validate billing fields; ensure Concur sync processes are updating users, vendors, and expenses accurately; monitor Wrike integration logs and elevate issues; maintain field mapping and oversee sync processes; track and resolve open integration issues with Operations.
    • Time Tracking Oversight: Validate daily timesheet entries; identify missing, misallocated, or excessive time entries; follow up; elevate noncompliance; ensure adherence to time entry policies for accurate utilization and billing.
    • Project Health & Status Monitoring: Monitor project dashboards in Wrike for task completion, budget consumption, and forecasted effort.
    • Reporting & Communication: Participate in syncs with Regional Managers; track upcoming projects, resourcing constraints, and urgent escalations; respond to inquiries; provide data for utilization, staffing, revenue forecasting, and other metrics.
    • Performance and Collaboration: Monitor workload balance across consultants; participate in resource reviews; collaborate cross‑functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Professional Services teams.
Qualifications
  • Experience: 4+ years in resource planning or operations within a software or technology organization.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and balance resources effectively in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Strong proficiency with resource planning tools (e.g., Wrike); working knowledge of JIRA, Salesforce, and NetSuite preferred.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and negotiation skills.

Title: Resource Manager, Professional Services

About us: Graphic Communications, a CAI Division, is a leading global provider of industry‑specific business and production software technology for the print industry. Graphic Communications' integrated and automated offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With over thirty years dedicated to delivering best‑in‑class technology to the packaging and printing industries, the company’s deeply held philosophy is that they succeed when their customers thrive.

Position Overview

The Resource Manager plays a critical role in ensuring Professional Services teams are properly staffed, aligned, and equipped to meet project timelines and business objectives. This role involves close collaboration with Project Managers, Project Coordinators, Regional Managers, the Sr. Director of Professional Services, Customer Success, and Sales to efficiently manage resources, balance workloads, and ensure smooth project delivery.

Core Responsibilities
  • Resource Planning and Allocation: Identify, assign, and allocate resources to ongoing and upcoming projects based on skills, availability, and priorities.
  • Maintain a real‑time view of resource capacity and project needs across the organization.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for project staffing and collaborate with Sales and Regional Managers to ensure proper coverage for upcoming engagements.
  • Own all new engagements at intake and assign resources based on availability and skillset.
  • Check in regularly with Project Managers to confirm they have the resources required for project success.
  • Maintain up‑to‑date skills and certifications records for all consultants.
  • Forecasting and Talent Management: collaborate with Sales, Project Managers, Regional Managers, and leadership to forecast future resource requirements; identify resource gaps and recommend cross‑training, recruitment, or subcontracting needs; support long‑term workforce planning and professional development of consultants.
  • Process Optimization and Tool Management: develop and maintain tools, dashboards, and reports to monitor utilization, productivity, and performance; establish and enforce consistent processes for resource requests and assignments; ensure data and processes remain aligned across systems.
  • Daily Operational Responsibilities – New Engagement Intake : review new projects pushed from Salesforce into Wrike; confirm all project metadata—customer, region, product, estimated hours, and key contacts; confirm the correct Wrike template and folder structure were created; if automation fails, manually create projects using Salesforce data.
  • Assignment & Scheduling: review unassigned Wrike projects daily; match consultants to projects based on skill set, availability, and regional needs; assign both primary and secondary consultants and confirm schedules with stakeholders; flag any assignment conflicts or delays to Regional Managers or Services Leads.
  • System Sync and Integration Oversight: cross‑reference Salesforce, Wrike, and NetSuite mappings to ensure accuracy; validate billing fields; ensure Concur sync processes are updating accurately; monitor Wrike integration logs and escalate issues; maintain field mapping and oversee sync processes across Salesforce, NetSuite, and Concur; track and resolve open integration issues.
  • Time Tracking Oversight: validate daily timesheet entries; identify missing, misallocated, or excessive time entries and follow up; escape persistent noncompliance to Regional Managers; ensure adherence to time entry policies.
  • Project Health & Status Monitoring: monitor project dashboards in Wrike for task completion, budget consumption, and forecasted effort.
  • Reporting & Communication: participate in regular syncs with Regional Managers; track upcoming projects, resourcing constraints, and urgent escalations; respond to inquiries regarding capacity; provide data for utilization, staffing, revenue forecasting, and other Professional Services metrics.
  • Performance and Collaboration: monitor workload balance across consultants; participate in resource reviews with Regional Managers and collaborate cross‑functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Professional Services teams.
Qualifications
  • Experience: 4+ years in resource planning or operations within a software or technology organization.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and balance resources effectively in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Strong proficiency with resource planning tools (e.g., Wrike); working knowledge of JIRA, Salesforce, and NetSuite preferred.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and negotiation skills.

title: Revenue Strategy Director
description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in 11 countries, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

GET TO KNOW US

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

Join a company shaping a healthier world.

THE OPPORTUNITY

The Sales Strategy Director is a critical, high‑impact leadership role within the Revenue Strategy & Enablement team. Reporting to the Senior Director of Revenue Strategy & Enablement, this director will be the architect and driver of our global B2B Sales Development (SDR/BDR) and Sales strategies.

The successful candidate will lead a team of 3 managerial‑level direct reports to establish foundational strategies, deliver actionable insights, and implement structured processes and enablement that maximize commercial performance and drive scalable revenue growth. This role is expected to operate as a strategic thought partner to the CRO and Senior Revenue Leaders.

YOUR IMPACT
  • Develop and execute a Global Sales Strategy, owning and driving key initiatives, process improvements, and projects with the support of Sales Leadership.
  • Formulate and develop business plans, identifying opportunities to improve go‑to‑market efficiencies and leading efforts to scale.
  • Collaborate closely with Marketing, Product Marketing, Sales Ops, Sales Tools, Finance, and Product teams to ensure strategic initiatives (e.g., new product launches, pricing changes) are smoothly operationalized and supported by the sales organization, accelerating growth in new geographies, products, and market segments.
  • Deliver enablement programs to increase efficiency and effectiveness across the B2B sales force.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to Sales Leadership, supporting global sales forces who sell to every industry and market across all countries we operate in.
  • Assess and drive innovative pricing strategies and options for sales teams, staying current with the competitive landscape and recommending changes that unlock new revenue streams.
  • Lead and mentor a team of three Sales Strategy Managers, fostering their professional development and ensuring the Sales Strategy function consistently delivers maximum commercial value.
  • Conduct sophisticated and creative analysis, then translate those results into easily digestible messages, communications, and presentations.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work‑life wellness.
WHO YOU ARE
  • A Strategic Architect with a strong track record in Sales Strategy or senior commercial leadership (Business Development, Sales), with SaaS, B2B, or Strategy Consulting experience as a plus.
  • You have extensive experience in designing and executing global Go‑to‑Market (GTM) models and sales enablement programs, partnering with GTM Teams to leverage sales performance and influence cross‑functional revenue programs.
  • A Data‑Driven Decision‑Maker who brings excellent quantitative analytical skills and a deep understanding of sales performance, metrics, sales funnel, sales methodologies, and CRM reporting (e.g., Salesforce).
  • A Cross‑Functional Collaborator with a strong ability to interact and influence effectively with senior stakeholders. You have proven experience partnering across Sales, Finance, Product, and Marketing teams to drive strategic decisions and consensus.
  • A Strong Communicator (written, verbal, and active listener) who possesses executive presence. You are capable of translating complex business goals into effective strategies and influencing outcomes.
  • A Resilient, Adaptable Professional who can think strategically while maintaining exceptional attention to detail to drive program management and execution. You embrace the fast‑paced, high‑growth environment of a global technology company and manage multiple, often ambiguous, strategic projects concurrently.
  • Proficient in English, with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly and effectively across global teams.
  • A People Leader who can thrive in a fully remote organization and act as a true team player.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in designing and executing global Go‑to‑Market models and proficiency in English are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:
  • WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.
  • WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on‑demand content.
  • HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.
  • FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.
  • FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.
  • PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!
  • PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp‑back period to return part‑time while they get settled.
  • CAREER GROWTH: Access world‑class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.
  • CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.
  • And to get a glimpse of life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn !
Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non‑disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Voluntary Self Identification

Wellhub is committed to providing a welcoming and inclusive work environment, beginning with the application process. We recognize that we are not all alike, and this is our greatest strength. We hire talented and diverse individuals not only because it is the right thing to do, but also because it strengthens our company. We know that combining our diverse cultures, experiences, and perspectives will help us achieve our mission of making the world a healthier place.

  • Information collected as part of this survey is anonymous; unrelated to your individual application; and has no bearing on your application; we will not know whether or not you complete this survey.
  • We use the data collected in aggregate only to improve our diversity and inclusion efforts.
