description:
O que nos move?

Claro, a paixão por esportes é indiscutível, mas também somos grandes amantes de inovação constante! Buscamos soluções digitais que conectem clubes, federações, ligas e marcas ao público de forma eficaz e inovadora. Nosso objetivo é construir um ecossistema que sustente o esporte nas próximas décadas, integrando o melhor do digital e da TV É assim que estamos fazendo história e queremos encontrar mais pessoas que acreditem no potencial do que estamos construindo e queiram fazer parte disso.

Dito isso, estamos em busca de uma pessoa para atuar como Coordenação de Infraestrutura de TI para jogar junto à nossa equipe de Engenharia e Operações em São Paulo . Na LiveMode, cada movimento é uma jogada para a liderança e inovação no mercado.

Como Coordenação de Infraestrutura de TI , sua missão será manter e evoluir a infraestrutura de servidores, redes e nuvem, garantindo segurança, disponibilidade e suporte a projetos técnicos da empresa, impulsionando não apenas nossa presença no mercado, mas também a forma como o esporte é vivenciado globalmente.

Responsabilidades
  • Gestão de infraestrutura híbrida: gerenciar servidores físicos, ambientes virtualizados e recursos em nuvem, assegurando estabilidade, segurança e desempenho contínuo dos sistemas corporativos.
  • Liderança técnica de equipe: coordenar uma equipe de pelo menos três profissionais de infraestrutura, promovendo boas práticas, capacitação técnica e um ambiente colaborativo focado em alta performance.
  • Planejamento e melhoria contínua: definir prioridades e conduzir projetos de migração, upgrades, automação e modernização de sistemas, buscando ganhos de eficiência e escalabilidade.
  • Monitoramento e resposta a incidentes: supervisionar a detecção e resolução de falhas em rede e sistemas, garantindo agilidade, documentação e prevenção de recorrências.
  • Manutenção e governança técnica: assegurar o cumprimento das políticas de segurança da informação e práticas de hardening, controle de acesso e segmentação de redes.
  • Integração interdepartamental: atuar em parceria com outras áreas de TI e de negócios, garantindo que a infraestrutura suporte as demandas corporativas e esteja alinhada aos objetivos estratégicos.
  • Cultura IA-driven e automação: fomentar o uso de inteligência artificial e automações para otimizar processos, ampliar a observabilidade e aumentar a eficiência operacional.
  • Gestão de equipe e performance: acompanhar indicadores de produtividade, aplicar feedbacks recorrentes e desenvolver a equipe técnica por meio de mentorias e capacitação constante.
  • Documentação e padronização: manter registros técnicos atualizados e acessíveis, promovendo a disseminação do conhecimento dentro da equipe e da área de TI.
Requisitos necessários
  • Formação acadêmica: ensino superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Redes de Computadores ou áreas correlatas.
  • Projetos e entregas técnicas: experiência comprovada na condução de projetos de infraestrutura, com histórico de implementação ou otimização de ambientes complexos.
  • Diagnóstico e troubleshooting: domínio em análise e resolução de incidentes envolvendo hardware, software, rede e sistemas operacionais.
  • Sistemas e servidores: conhecimento avançado em Microsoft Windows Server (AD, DNS, DHCP, GPO, File Server) e servidores Linux (Ubuntu, CentOS, Debian), com uso de shell script e ferramentas de monitoramento.
  • Virtualização e conteinerização: vivência com VMware vSphere, Hyper‑V e noções de Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Nuvem pública: experiência em ambientes Azure, AWS ou GCP.
  • Segurança da informação: domínio de boas práticas de hardening, segregação de redes e controle de acessos.
  • Redes e conectividade: experiência com infraestrutura LAN/WAN, firewalls, roteadores Mikrotik, Access Points Ubiquiti UniFi, VLANs, VPNs e ferramentas de monitoramento (Zabbix, PRTG).
  • Liderança técnica comprovada: histórico de gestão de equipes de infraestrutura ou coordenação de times técnicos.
  • Mentalidade IA-driven: curiosidade e prática ativa na aplicação de ferramentas de inteligência artificial e automações para otimizar a operação e o monitoramento da infraestrutura.
Diferenciais desejáveis
  • Certificações profissionais: DELL EMC – DCA/DCS, ITIL Foundation, VMware VCP‑CMA, MCSA, Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert, CompTIA A+/Network+, LPI‑201/202 ou ISO 27001:2022.
  • Inglês a partir de intermediário: leitura e comunicação técnica em ambientes corporativos.
  • Ferramentas de automação e orquestração: conhecimento em n8n, Zapier, Make ou ferramentas semelhantes, aplicadas à integração de sistemas e agentes de IA.
  • Visão estratégica e colaborativa: capacidade de traduzir necessidades técnicas em soluções de negócio, promovendo alinhamento entre tecnologia e resultados organizacionais.
Nossa cultura

Na LiveMode, nossa missão é Transformar e Crescer o Esporte , e nossos valores são o combustível que nos move no dia a dia. Acreditamos que crescer exige inconformismo, ambição e consistência. Nossa cultura nasce disso: de gente que não aceita o que está aí, que quer fazer mais, aprender mais e entregar mais — sempre com responsabilidade e visão de futuro. Quem está na LiveMode está aqui para marcar a história do esporte no Brasil e no Mundo.

SOMOS EMPREENDEDORES ontem, hoje e sempre

Escolhemos o gol e corremos atrás dele com tudo. Focamos em poucas prioridades e vamos até o fim, sem distrações. Tratamos cada recurso como se fosse nosso, decidindo rápido e com coragem. Comunicação? Direta, aberta e na velocidade do jogo.

SOMOS UM TIME DE ALTA PERFORMANCE não uma família ou uma confraria de amigos

Família a gente não escolhe, mas o time escolhe quem joga. E quando o jogo é grande, não dá pra carregar quem não tá entregando. Aqui, a gente decide pelo que é melhor pra empresa, não pra uma área ou pessoa. Toda entrega tem um dono claro, que vai até o fim. Processos ajudam, mas não mandam: quem resolve são as pessoas.

SOMOS AMBICIOSOS pensamos sempre grande

A gente já fez muita coisa grande. Mas quem está na LiveMode sabe que dá pra ir além. Porque quem é ambicioso de verdade vive com a sensação de que sempre dá pra melhorar, crescer, fazer mais impacto. Aqui, a ambição não é discurso. É prática. E é ela que nos leva a quebrar recorde atrás de recorde.

O QUE NOS MOVE É O FUTURO

Na LiveMode, o futuro já está em movimento — e quem não acompanha, fica pra trás. Por isso, tratamos tecnologia com urgência: testamos, aprendemos e aplicamos com velocidade. Queremos ser uma empresa IA first, porque acreditamos que dominar essas ferramentas não é opcional — é o que vai nos ajudar a alcançar nossa missão mais rápido. IA não é extra. É parte central do nosso dia a dia.

Acreditamos na transparência das relações, na valorização das conquistas e não abrimos mão dos valores que nos trouxeram até aqui. Temos certeza de que dia após dia construímos o futuro que queremos e esse futuro se apresenta em nosso propósito: construir sonhos que transformam o mundo.

Graphic Communications, a CAI Division, is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for the print industy.

Graphic Communications' integrated and automated offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies.

With over thirty years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the packaging and printing industries, it is the company's deeply held philosophy that they succeed when its customers thrive.

Position Overview

The Resource Manager plays a critical role in ensuring Professional Services teams are properly staffed, aligned, and equipped to meet project timelines and business objectives.

This role involves close collaboration with Project Managers, Project Coordinators, Regional Managers, the Sr.

Director of Professional Services, Customer Success, and Sales to efficiently manage resources, balance workloads, and ensure smooth project delivery.

Core Responsibilities

Resource Planning and Allocation

Identify, assign, and allocate resources to ongoing and upcoming projects based on skills, availability, and priorities.

Maintain a real-time view of resource capacity and project needs across the organization.

Serve as the primary point of contact for project staffing and collaborate with Sales and Regional Managers to ensure proper coverage for upcoming engagements.

Own all new engagements at intake and assign resources based on availability and skillset.

Check in regularly with Project Managers to confirm they have the resources required for project success.

Maintain up-to-date skills and certifications records for all consultants.

Forecasting and Talent Management

Collaborate with Sales, Project Managers, Regional Managers, and leadership to forecast future resource requirements.

Identify resource gaps and recommend cross-training, recruitment, or subcontracting needs based on upcoming opportunities.

Support long-term workforce planning and professional development of consultants.

Process Optimization and Tool Management

Develop and maintain tools, dashboards, and reports to monitor utilization, productivity, and performance.

Establish and enforce consistent processes for resource requests and assignments to maximize efficiency.

Ensure data and processes remain aligned across systems.

Daily Operational Responsibilities

New Engagement Intake

Review new projects pushed from Salesforce into Wrike.

Confirm all project metadata: customer, region, product, estimated hours, and key contacts.

Confirm the correct Wrike template and folder structure were created.

If automation fails, manually create projects using Salesforce data.

Assignment & Scheduling

Review unassigned Wrike projects daily.

Match consultants to projects based on skill set, availability, and regional needs.

Assign both primary and secondary consultants and confirm schedules with stakeholders.

Flag any assignment conflicts or delays to Regional Managers or Services Leads.

System Sync and Integration Oversight

Cross-reference Salesforce ? Wrike and Wrike ? NetSuite mappings to ensure accuracy.

Validate billing fields (sold-to ID, billing trigger, engagement type) and confirm correct syncing.

Ensure Concur sync processes are updating users, vendors, and expenses accurately.

Monitor Wrike integration logs and escalate issues as needed.

Maintain field mapping and oversee sync processes across Salesforce, NetSuite, and Concur.

Track and resolve open integration issues in collaboration with Operations.

Time Tracking Oversight

Validate daily timesheet entries for all consultants.

Identify missing, misallocated, or excessive time entries and follow up as needed.

Escalate persistent noncompliance to Regional Managers.

Ensure adherence to time entry policies for accurate utilization and billing reporting.

Project Health & Status Monitoring

Monitor project dashboards in Wrike for task completion, budget consumption, and forecasted effort.

Reporting & Communication

Participate in regular syncs with Regional Managers.

Track upcoming projects, resourcing constraints, and urgent escalations.

Respond to inquiries regarding capacity, project swaps, or timeline adjustments.

Provide data for utilization, staffing, revenue forecasting, and any other Professional Services metrics.

Performance and Collaboration

Monitor workload balance across consultants.

Participate in resource reviews with Regional Managers to support continuous development based on Sales forecast.

Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Professional Services teams to align timelines, priorities, and dependencies.

Qualifications

Experience:

4+ years of experience in resource planning or operations within a software or technology organization.

Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and balance resources effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Skills

Strong proficiency with resource planning tools (e.g., Wrike)

Excellent organizational, communication, and negotiation skills.

title: AI Augmented Software Engineer Senior
description:
PALO IT is a global technology consultancy that crafts tech as a force for good. We design, develop and scale digital and sustainable products and services to unlock value across the triple bottom line: people, planet, profit. We do the right thing, we do it right. We’re proud to be a World Economic Forum New Champion, and a B Corp-certified company.

We are small enough to care locally, big enough to deliver globally (5 continents, 18 offices, +650 experts from +50 nationalities)

We are robust and resilient (100% independent and 0 debt)

We are entrepreneurs and passionate experts: We invest in what we believe genuinely and work as a collective intelligence

We are positive, courageous, caring, doers and committed to excellence

About Gen-e2

While the market is still largely AI-augmenting delivery, we have reinvented the SDLC to be AI First. Our approach is a game-changer in productivity and quality, with a strong collaboration between IA generative and our best Talents:

We now generate 95% of the entire product — code, documentation, infrastructure as code, and even design — with GitHub Copilot.

The quality consistently exceeds the output of our best traditional engineering teams.

A product repository houses all product artefacts, giving AI full project context for higher-quality generation.

A library of rules and prompts defines coding standards, design principles, and security guidelines, ensuring enterprise-grade quality and scalability.

With Gen-e2, we deliver end-to-end products 2–3× faster than traditional approaches, while raising the bar for engineering excellence.

Your Role

You will leverage your software development expertise and cutting-edge AI tools to accelerate development cycles and drive innovation. As a key member of our team, you will apply your skills in software development, application architecture, and problem-solving to build rapid prototypes and production-ready solutions. You'll use AI-powered development tools to improve code quality, automate daily tasks, and speed up delivery—while maintaining high engineering standards.

Working closely with project teams and business stakeholders, you’ll bring your technical expertise to catalyze innovation using both traditional development practices and AI-augmented environments.

Your soft skills will help you build or be part of a high-performing engineering team that consistently exceeds expectations by effectively combining human expertise and AI capabilities.

Your Mission

As a tech consultant , your mission is both external and internal .

Externally, with clients, you will:
  • Write code following best practices and a software craftsmanship mindset—augmented by AI
  • Proactively suggest, test, and adapt tools and methods that best fit the context of your assignment
  • Conduct code, accessibility, performance, and security audits using both your expertise and AI-assisted analysis
  • Listen, rephrase, create diagrams, lead workshops... in short, do everything to ensure ongoing mutual understanding
  • Participate in, facilitate, and/or organize Agile ceremonies in your projects
  • Suggest improvements to your client and team members for better ways of working
  • Design simple, scalable architectures adapted to various contexts using AI-driven approaches
  • Leverage AI tools to troubleshoot and efficiently solve technical problems
  • Stay up to date with emerging technologies and AI development practices
Internally, at PALO IT, within the Tech Hive , you will:
  • Join our internal technical community (experience sharing, tech watch, support)
  • Collaborate with colleagues on process and/or tool improvement initiatives
  • Take part in our training and positive-impact workshops: sustainable tech, climate fresk, 2tonnes, accessibility, etc.
Examples of Projects We’ve Done
  • Developed an app to manage a company’s fleet of electric cars
  • Built a SaaS platform for the circular economy to support tool reuse
  • Created an app to optimize the yield of a pepper farm in Cambodia
  • Carried out technical, organizational, and UX audits—paired up—at a VR software publisher and a wine industry client
  • Designed and facilitated workshops on sustainable tech and accessibility; led 2tonnes workshops
Your Profile

Our consultants come from very diverse backgrounds, and we’re proud of that richness. Describing our future colleague could take hours, so here are a few key points:

  • You’re technologically agnostic and enjoy discovering and implementing new tech stacks
  • You are proactive, curious , and open to different perspectives and backgrounds
  • You are skilled in using AI code assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Continue, Code Assist, Cursor…) for code generation and problem-solving
  • You understand fast engineering principles for optimal interaction with AI tools
  • You have a critical mindset to validate and verify AI-generated code and solutions
  • You are committed to continuous learning and keeping up with the fast-evolving AI landscape
  • You are open to cross-functional roles when project quality requires it
  • You care about social and environmental issues and Tech for Good
  • You value the social and environmental impacts of what you build
More About PALO IT

We’re eager to adapt to change, learn from our experiences and move to meet our planet’s urgent needs. We are continuously taking action to:

  • Deliver projects with a positive impact
  • Train 100% of our workforce on impact
  • Achieve B Corp certification among all our offices across the globe
  • Continuously measure & improve employee happiness

Our clients are amongst the world’s most successful companies. We innovate with both established Fortune 1000s, SMEs and start-ups who aim to make an impact, become global leaders and address the world’s most complex challenges.

What We Offer
  • Stimulating working environments
  • Unique career path
  • International mobility
  • Internal R&D projects
  • Knowledge sharing
  • Personalized training

For more on our team culture and benefits, check out our careers page and our PALOCast with testimonies from our Palowans!

PALO IT is an equal opportunity employer that values merit, qualifications, and abilities. We prioritize privacy and data security. For more information on our privacy practices, please refer to our Privacy Policy.

Escalate persistent noncompliance to Regional Managers.

title: Medico do Trabalho - Londrina / PR
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

O Imtep, é uma referência nacional no seu ramo e conta com uma completa infraestrutura para a gestão global de Saúde Empresarial de clientes de pequeno, médio ou grande porte, nacionais e multinacionais.

Oferece serviços com alta qualidade e dentro da legislação vigente proporcionando às seus clientes, colaboradores e fornecedores um ambiente seguro e saudável, ativando nessa parceria entrega eficiente, inspiração para cumprimento de prazos e satisfação constante do cliente final.

E para cumprirmos com os compromissos assumidos e a satisfação do cliente, buscamos estruturar nosso time de profissionais com alto desempenho, grande capacidade de relacionamento interpessoal, perfil proativo, comprometido e que se identifique com serviços voltados a urgência e emergência. Se você é essa pessoa, mande o seu currículo pra nós, pois teremos o prazer em tê-lo (a) no nosso time.

RESPONSIBILITIES AND ASSIGNMENTS
  • Liderar a equipe de enfermeiros e técnicos de enfermagem do trabalho;
  • Implementar e supervisionar a gestão da rotina e efetividade dos programas de EHS nas suas unidades;
  • Garantir o cumprimento da legislação vigente, das diretrizes definidas pelo cliente e dos requisitos de acreditação / certificação e auditoria interna relacionados a EHS; Procedimentos e manuais de EHS;
  • Garantir a atualização e a implementação do PCMSO (Programa de Controle Médico de Saúde Ocupacional) e que o PCMSO esteja alinhado com o PGR (Programa de Gerenciamento de Riscos);
  • Gerenciar e acompanhar as convocações dos exames ocupacionais, atendimentos assistenciais a todos os colaboradores que apresentem agravos de saúde de baixa e média complexidade;
  • Realizar atendimentos de acidentes de trabalho, típico e de trajeto, a fim de fazer diagnóstico de situações de urgência ou emergência médica;
  • Encaminhar funcionário para atendimento externo quando a situação o exigir, englobando atendimento no Pronto Socorro da unidade local ou outro serviço que seja necessário;
  • Atender funcionários que se apresentam com atestados médicos externos, com o objetivo de avaliar sua condição de saúde e retificar seu período de afastamento proposto;
  • Elaborar informação médica de qualidade e compatível com a realidade de saúde do colaborador e disponibilizá-la em prontuário clínico-ocupacional;
  • Propor discussão de melhorias para situações / postos de trabalho que possam estar gerando os agravos de saúde. Implementar ações educativas e treinamentosrelacionados à EHS.
REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS
  • Graduação em Medicina e pós-graduação em Medicina do Trabalho
  • Registro ativo e regular no CRM;
  • Experiência na área Ocupacional.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

Sobre o Imtep

O Imtep faz parte da maior companhia de gestão de saúde do Brasil, a 3778. Representa o maior operador de ambulatórios corporativos do país, atendendo empresas nacionais de grande porte e multinacionais. São mais de 200 unidades espalhadas em todo o Brasil, com cerca de 2 mil colaboradores espalhados em 120 cidades.

Além da gestão de ambulatório, as empresas têm ainda como principais serviços a Atenção Primária em Saúde, o atendimento em Saúde Ocupacional e o desenvolvimento de soluções tecnológicas em saúde.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Data Migrations (Remote Contractor, Brazil)
description:
Senior Software Engineer - Data Migrations (Remote Contractor, Brazil)

Join to apply for the Senior Software Engineer - Data Migrations (Remote Contractor, Brazil) role at Kuali, Inc.

About the Role

We're hiring two Senior Software Engineers as remote contractors to help design and build the internal tooling that will power our large-scale migration from Classic to the new Kuali Platform versions of our products.

You’ll be focused on data-heavy engineering : building frameworks, services, and utilities that make it safe, observable, and repeatable to move customer data between generations of our products.

Our stack for this work is Node.js and Postgres, and you’ll be working with both schema-based and schema-less applications (e.g., relational data plus JSON / NoSQL-style payloads) that need to be analyzed, transformed, and migrated.

We're a remote-first, results-driven team that values impact over hours.

Fridays are kept flexible to wrap up anything outstanding, and success in this role is measured by the results you deliver and the impact you create—not by time spent online.

Who Are We? Kuali builds software solutions for higher education.

We help our customers — colleges & universities — focus on providing a fantastic education to students by decreasing their administrative costs.

We work in a competitive space, ripe for innovation, with users ready to be delighted.

We are poised for high growth.

Our Culture
  • Iterate to evolve
  • Cultivate openness
  • Act with accountability
  • Assume the best
  • Practice humility
  • Deliver amazing experiences
Drive outcomes

At Kuali, we learn from and teach each other, we practice transparency and empathy, we delight in delivering value to our customers, and we WIN!

We've embraced distributed work for years—it's part of who we are.

Many of our employees work remotely across the U.S., from Massachusetts to Seattle, while others collaborate in person at our office locations.

We're intentional about creating a healthy, connected culture no matter where you work.

What You’ll Do
  • Design and build internal migration tooling in Node.js and Postgres to support moving data from Classic to new Platform versions of our products.
  • Create reusable frameworks to define and execute migration plans (schemas, mappings, transformation rules, validation steps).
  • Work with both relational and schema-less data (e.g., JSON / NoSQL structures) and design safe ways to transform and load them into new models.
  • Implement robust observability into migration runs (logging, metrics, dashboards, tracing) to make runs debuggable and auditable.
  • Design for idempotency, replayability, and rollback so migrations can be retried safely and failures are easy to investigate.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to understand domain models and migration requirements, then turn them into robust tools and workflows.
  • Contribute to data modeling, performance tuning, and query optimization in Postgres to handle large datasets efficiently.
  • Use tests and automation to ensure migration logic is correct, resilient, and maintainable over time.
  • Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and continuous improvement of our internal tooling ecosystem.
About You

We're looking for curious, enthusiastic, empathetic engineers who love working with data and building the tools others rely on.

You
  • Have 3+ years of professional software engineering experience building web or backend applications.
  • Have demonstrable experience with data-heavy systems—migrations, ETL, integration tooling, reporting platforms, or similar.
  • Are comfortable working across the stack but are especially strong on the backend and data layer.
  • Understand how to build solutions with an agile, iterative approach, and you like collaborating closely with other engineers and stakeholders.
  • Care deeply about correctness, safety, and reliability, especially when dealing with customer data.
  • Are comfortable owning complex systems end-to-end—from design through deployment and ongoing improvements.
  • Use tests (unit, integration, regression) to validate your work and don't rely on others to catch basic issues.
Required Skills
  • Location: Based in Brazil, working as a remote contractor in near-shore time zones.
  • Language: Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Backend: Strong experience with Node.js (TypeScript / JavaScript).
  • Database: Strong experience with relational databases, ideally Postgres (schema design, query optimization, migrations).
  • Data & Tooling: Experience building internal tools, migration frameworks, ETL pipelines, or other data-intensive systems.
  • Comfort working with schema-less data (e.g., JSON structures, flexible document models) and mapping them to structured schemas.
  • Cloud: Experience with AWS or another major cloud provider.
  • Engineering Practices: Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills.
  • Solid testing habits and code quality standards.
  • Experience with CI / CD workflows.
We’d Be Delighted If You Bring Experience With
  • Experience with NoSQL or document databases (e.g., Elasticsearch, MongoDB, or similar).
  • Experience with logging and observability tooling (structured logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards).
  • Experience with Elixir or interest in learning it on the job.
  • Background in data migrations, legacy system modernization, or large-scale platform upgrades.
  • Experience owning and maintaining complex, long-lived internal systems.
How We Work
  • Remote-first & results-driven: We care about the outcomes you deliver, not the hours you're online.
  • Collaborative culture: We practice transparency, empathy, and assume the best in one another.
  • Continuous learning: We know great developers can learn new tools; what matters is your ability to reason about systems, data, and trade-offs.
Perks
  • Remote-first and results-driven
  • 4-Day work week!
  • Competitive fixed monthly pay
  • Space to work on self-driven projects during quarterly "hack weeks"
  • Kuali has been voted a top place to work for 9 years by the Salt Lake Tribune.
In
  • TIME Magazine honored us by naming Kuali to their list of the World's Top EdTech Companies, ranking us #99 overall and #37 in the US.

At Kuali, we value and respect individuals from all backgrounds, recognizing that a rich tapestry of experiences and perspectives fuels our success as a company and enriches our collective human experience.

description:
Job Description

Trade Marketing within our Company’s Vaccines Business Unit has evolved significantly from an operational and tactical focus in the private healthcare system to a strategic function responsible for developing complex points‑of‑vaccination and distribution strategies across the full portfolio in both specialty and retail pharmacy channels. A key component of this evolution is the needs of stakeholders in the specialty pharmacy channel, in which our Company has a significant footprint of vaccines supporting from infants to adults. Immunization therapies often require special storage, handling and administration, and typically involve a significant degree of coordination of specific healthcare ecosystem, including general population – not patients, HCPs and clinics, laboratories, hospital and pharmacies.

This market has been changing on last years, from a market dominated by clinics, many times managed by physicians, to a complex and competitive market with entrance of big chains of pharmacies, laboratories and vaccination at home.

Move the mindset of population is another relevant challenge of private vaccines market, especially on adult cohort, bringing the importance of prevention instead of disease treatment, and point of vaccination has an important role on this field.

In this scenario Associate Director of Trade Marketing & Strategic Partnerships is an essential position, creating a collaborative atmosphere to ensure the entire journey for prevention of diseases.

TheAssociate Director of Trade Marketing & Strategic Partnerships – Private Vaccines is responsible for assessing and identifying business opportunities in the fast-evolving private points of vaccination, then PoVs in support of healthcare consumers (HCCs), especially adults. This role, supporting all vaccines portfolio and pipeline products requires an understanding of the PoV and distribution channel and its complexities and challenges, coupled with a strategic mind with an eye towards innovation.

Key job responsibilities include (but are not limited to):
  • Lead the development of our company Vaccines Business Unit strategy to partner with laboratories, pharmacies and big immunization clinics (BICs) in their effort to accelerate connection with HCCs, leveraging technology to not only facilitate vaccination, but also PoVs initiatives to increase access.
  • Execute launch excellence in the Trade channel by overseeing the successful preparation of a diverse mix of stakeholders to drive key vaccines launches.
  • Identify new, strategic channel partners that will support and enhance the vision to innovate and meet the evolving HCC needs in the point of vaccination.
  • Lead for the strategic development and execution of multiple brand Trade value propositions throughout the brand lifecycle by collaborating with Brand leadership and other cross‑functional partners.
  • Lead the development and creation of high‑impact promotional materials for the PoV that supports HCC needs and brand strategic objectives.
  • Manage relationships with internal business partners, product managers (HCP and HCC strategy), commercial, supply and medical teams.
  • Manage strategic agency partner and development of Trade strategies and tactics across therapeutic areas.
  • Embrace the Trade Marketing culture by cultivating an inclusive environment that encourages synchronicity, agility, transparency and development.
  • Synthesize complex, and sometimes incomplete, PoV data sets in order to inform key strategic decisions.

  • Bachelor’s Degree required
  • Advanced English preferred
  • Experience with contract negotiation
  • Marketing experience preferred
  • Vaccines area experience preferred

  • Knowledge of Marketing concepts within strategic planning process and understanding of market research principles to draw valid conclusions and inform recommendations

  • Strong communication skills
  • Demonstrated experience developing and managing projects cross‑functionally
  • Positive, solutions‑oriented attitude

description:
Job Title : Regulatory Research Analyst Location : Brazil

Work Mode : 100% Remote

Employment Type : Independent Contractor (hourly pay, no benefits, and you’re responsible for your own taxes)

Contract Duration : 6 months (with possibility of extension)

Hours : 40 hours per week

Overview

We are seeking an experienced Regulatory Research Analyst to join the Tax & Regulations team of a global independent support provider. This fully remote role focuses on researching and tracking global trade regulations —primarily across LATAM and North America—and contributing insights that help keep SAP GTS systems up to date for global clients. The analyst will act as the first point of contact for new legal and regulatory changes and work closely with Business Analysts and ERP / GTS specialists. Client interaction is minimal; the role is primarily research-oriented.

Key Responsibilities Regulatory Research & Analysis

Monitor and maintain up-to‑date awareness of legislative and regulatory changes in assigned countries using government websites, agencies, third‑party sources, and in‑country experts.

Track global trade compliance regulations, including customs duties, export controls, sanctions, tariff updates, and other relevant requirements across jurisdictions (U.S., Canada, LATAM, etc.).

Interpret, analyze, and document new or amended legislation in an internal repository with high accuracy and clarity.

Prepare comparative analyses of regulatory changes when required.

Ensure research and documentation meet ISO process standards.

SAP GTS Alignment
  • Export Control & Licensing
  • Import Control & Market Access
  • Sanctions & Restricted Party Compliance
  • Customs & Tariff Management
  • Trade Agreements & Origin Management
  • Regulatory Reporting & Declarations
  • Product & Classification Compliance
Collaboration & Documentation

Deliver clear summaries and detailed regulatory insights needed by ERP and product specialists to implement system changes for clients.

Collaborate with Business Analysts and fellow researchers to validate findings and maintain consistency.

Support research expansion into Indirect Tax topics (VAT, GST, country‑specific filing requirements) where applicable.

Must-Have Qualifications

Bilingual : English + one LATAM language (Spanish or Portuguese).

5+ years of professional experience in tax, global trade, or international regulatory research.

Working knowledge of SAP GTS or similar trade compliance systems.

Familiarity with international trade laws and frameworks (EAR, ITAR, EU Dual Use, WCO, etc.).

Strong research, analytical, and documentation skills with excellent attention to detail.

Nice-to-Have Skills

Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and handle multiple tasks under pressure.

Strong internet‑based research capabilities and proficiency in business applications (Microsoft Office, Google tools, SharePoint, etc.).

Experience compiling complex regulatory information into clear, actionable summaries.

Technical understanding of SAP ERP tax / accounting workflows (advantageous, not mandatory).

Familiarity with tools like Excel, PDF generation, ABBYY FineReader, Deepl, Inoreader, Beyond Compare (training provided).

Self‑starter with strong initiative, resourcefulness, and team‑oriented mindset.

Additional background in finance or tax is a plus.

Why Join Us?

Work remotely while contributing to high‑impact global compliance research.

Collaborate with a diverse international team of trade and tax experts.

Play a key role in helping global clients stay compliant with rapidly evolving regulations.

A curiosidade e a busca constante por conhecimento são a base do sucesso na IBM Consulting. Em sua função, você será incentivado a desafiar o convencional, investigar ideias fora do seu escopo de atuação e apresentar soluções criativas que gerem impacto inovador para uma ampla rede de clientes. Nossa cultura de evolução e empatia prioriza o crescimento profissional a longo prazo e oportunidades de desenvolvimento em um ambiente que valoriza suas habilidades e experiências únicas.

Your Role And Responsibilities

Como Associate na IBM, você trabalhará para solucionar problemas de negócios usando ferramentas de ponta e de código aberto, como Python, R e TensorFlow, combinadas com ferramentas da IBM e nossos pacotes de aplicativos de IA. title: Trade Compliance Analyst
description:
Job Title

Regulatory Research Analyst

Location

Brazil

Work Mode

100% Remote

Employment Type

Independent Contractor (hourly pay, no benefits, and you're responsible for your own taxes)

Contract Duration

6 months (with possibility of extension)

Hours

40 hours per week

Overview

We are seeking an experienced Regulatory Research Analyst to join the Tax & Regulations team of a global independent support provider. This fully remote role focuses on researching and tracking global trade regulations—primarily across LATAM and North America—and contributing insights that help keep SAP GTS systems up to date for global clients. The analyst will act as the first point of contact for new legal and regulatory changes and work closely with Business Analysts and ERP / GTS specialists. Client interaction is minimal; the role is primarily research-oriented.

Key Responsibilities
  • Monitor and maintain up-to-date awareness of legislative and regulatory changes in assigned countries using government websites, agencies, third‑party sources, and in‑country experts.
  • Track global trade compliance regulations, including customs duties, export controls, sanctions, tariff updates, and other relevant requirements across jurisdictions (U.S., Canada, LATAM, etc.).
  • Interpret, analyze, and document new or amended legislation in an internal repository with high accuracy and clarity.
  • Prepare comparative analyses of regulatory changes when required.
  • Ensure research and documentation meet ISO process standards.
SAP GTS Alignment
  • Research and provide insights relevant to SAP GTS (v11 or similar), supporting product specialists on topics such as: Export Control & Licensing, Import Control & Market Access, Sanctions & Restricted Party Compliance, Customs & Tariff Management, Trade Agreements & Origin Management, Regulatory Reporting & Declarations, Product & Classification Compliance.

Deliver clear summaries and detailed regulatory insights needed by ERP and product specialists to implement system changes for clients. Collaborate with Business Analysts and fellow researchers to validate findings and maintain consistency. Support research expansion into Indirect Tax topics (VAT, GST, country‑specific filing requirements) where applicable.

Must‑Have Qualifications
  • Bilingual: English + one LATAM language (Spanish or Portuguese).
  • 5+ years of professional experience in tax, global trade, or international regulatory research.
  • Working knowledge of SAP GTS or similar trade compliance systems.
  • Familiarity with international trade laws and frameworks (EAR, ITAR, EU Dual Use, WCO, etc.).
  • Strong research, analytical, and documentation skills with excellent attention to detail.
Nice‑to‑Have Skills
  • Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and handle multiple tasks under pressure.
  • Strong internet‑based research capabilities and proficiency in business applications (Microsoft Office, Google tools, SharePoint, etc.).
  • Experience compiling complex regulatory information into clear, actionable summaries.
  • Technical understanding of SAP ERP tax / accounting workflows (advantageous, not mandatory).
Technical Tools
  • Familiarity with tools like Excel, PDF generation, ABBYY FineReader, Deepl, Inoreader, Beyond Compare (training provided).
Additional Background

Self‑starter with strong initiative, resourcefulness, and team‑oriented mindset. Additional background in finance or tax is a plus.

Why Join Us?

Work remotely while contributing to high‑impact global compliance research. Collaborate with a diverse international team of trade and tax experts. Play a key role in helping global clients stay compliant with rapidly evolving regulations.

Our Medical Affairs team advances patient care by engaging in scientific exchange with external medical experts and industry professionals ensuring the scientific value of our products is realized.

We engage and train internal employees to ensure that they thoroughly comprehend the science behind the medicine and review further unmet medical needs to bolster collaboration and further differentiate our portfolio.

  • Description
  • MSL (Medical Scientific Liaisons) are scientifically trained and credentialed therapeutic area, disease, and product experts who engage in non-promotional scientific exchange with Scientific Leaders or Key Decision Makers.

MSL (Medical Scientific Liaisons) interactions with Scientific Leaders and Key Decision Makers are built on the credibility of the scientific exchange held.

MSLs (Medical Scientific Liaisons) develop and execute on action plans aligned with the Guiding Principles for example, US Global Medical Affairs / Oncology Global Medical Affairs External Stakeholder-Facing Activities, local and global company policies, local rules & regulations, and the Medical Affairs Plan (MAP).

  • The MSL (Medical Scientific Liaisons) is a field-based medical professional whose primary responsibility is to engage in non-promotional peer-to-peer communication & provide medical / scientific information to Scientific Leaders and Key Decision Makers based on cutting‑edge scientific exchange and services oriented towards the stakeholder's professional interests & needs.
Requirements
  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences;
  • Master's or PhD in cardiology, pulmonology or related areas will be considered a differential;
  • Advanced English;
  • Ability to interpret data and scientific articles;
  • Travel is a requirement.

We are a research‑driven biopharmaceutical company.

Our mission is built on the simple premise that if we "follow the science" that great medicines can make a significant impact to our world.

We believe that a research‑driven enterprise dedicated to world‑class science can succeed by inventing medicine and vaccine innovations that make a difference for patients across the globe.

Overview

We are looking for an experienced and highly technical professional to join the Business Technology (BT) organization. A solutions architect creates the overall technical vision for a specific solution to a business problem. They design, describe, and manage the solution. In many ways, this person builds the bridge between a business problem and the technology solution and outlines each of the phases and requirements required to make that solution work.

Essential Functions
  • Design and develop innovative, scalable, efficient and secure solutions such as Quality Automation architecture and platforms for automation with API and messaging based test frameworks with Global scale readiness.

  • Developing proof-of-concept projects to validate proposed solutions.
  • Bring a new & alternative perspective when reviewing and validating solutions designs from other team members.
  • As a Solution Architecture expert, demonstrate thought leadership & influence beyond the scope of your own team and throughout Bunge.
  • Accountable for developing & monitoring the solution’s budget.
  • Advise and support strategy and business technology leaders to understand, apply, monetize, and operationalize existing, new, and emerging technologies to transform automation requirements into scalable and resilient solutions.

  • 6+ years of experience as QA Automation Architecture roles for end-to-end automation design experience.
  • 11+ year of experience in designing & developing large scale, global solutions leveraging methodologies such as Quality Engineering, Automation Tools and framework such as Selenium, Junit, Cucumber, Postman, Selenium, TOSCA or similar.

  • Advanced programming skills including automation systems and databases.
  • Familiarity with programming script languages including Java and VBScript.
  • Strong understanding on API Testing, TestNG with Rest Assured/Web Services and SQL dB development experience.
  • Integrate cloud automation solutions into CI/CD pipelines and software delivery processes.

  • Build partnerships, appropriately influence to gain commitment, foster talent and coach others to grow in current or future roles.

Looking to the future, our ambition is to continuously reinvent ourselves, leveraging data to be at the forefront of analytics, technology and talent to accomplish our purpose in a better, faster and simpler way. Bunge is committed to operating and thriving in the digital world - creating world class agile teams where teammates are empowered and encouraged to collaborate and test and learn to succeed.

Most importantly, in all we do we live our values:

  • Drive for Excellence by being agile, innovative and efficient
  • Do What’s Right by acting safely, ethically, and sustainably
Overview

We are looking for an experienced and highly technical professional to join the Business Technology (BT) organization. A solutions architect creates the overall technical vision for a specific solution to a business problem. They design, describe, and manage the solution. In many ways, this person builds the bridge between a business problem and the technology solution and outlines each of the phases and requirements required to make that solution work.

Essential Functions
  • Design and develop innovative, scalable, efficient and secure solutions such as, (Quality Automation architecture and platforms for automation with API and messaging based test frameworks) with Global scale readiness.
  • On a global scale across Bunge, within a highly complex projects and ever changing environment, lead the design, development and advancement of (test automation framework for Enterprise platforms ensuring reusability and maintainability of test scripts).
  • Applies highly technical expertise to provide recommendations and roadmaps which solve complex problems without clear precedent.
  • Design, debug, and monitor performance of solutions.
  • Documenting and sharing best practice knowledge for new solutions.
  • Regularly communicating new features and benefits to partners, internal customers, and other stakeholders.
  • Providing technical leadership to Agile Squads and/or DevOps development teams, ranging in size from 6-8 team members, throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Developing proof-of-concept projects to validate your proposed solutions.
  • Bring a new & alternative perspective when reviewing and validating solutions designs from other team members.
  • As a Solution Architecture expert, demonstrate thought leadership & influence beyond the scope or your own team and throughout Bunge.
  • Accountable for developing & monitoring the solution’s budget.
  • Advise and support strategy and business technology leaders to understand, apply, monetize, and operationalize existing, new, and emerging technologies to transform automation requirements into scalable and resilient solutions.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education & experience required, computer science degree preferred.
  • 6+ years of experience as QA Automation Architecture roles for end-to-end automation design experience.
  • 11+ years of experience in designing & developing large scale, global solutions leveraging methodologies such as (Quality Engineering, Automation Tools and framework such as Selenium, Junit, Cucumber, Postman, Selenium, TOSCA or similar).
  • Proficiency in complex automated software test suite for SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft, Google GPC and Integration Platforms.
  • Develop and maintain test plans that cover all aspects of the product.
  • Automate test cases to reduce manual effort, improve test coverage and considerably reduce testing timelines.
  • Lead and execute the development and execution of automated test scripts across a variety of applications, work with development team to identify and fix defects early in the development process and reduce time to market.
  • Extensive architecting test automation suite experience with standard creation, procedure enforcement, and execution monitoring.
  • Extensive automation experience with Test automation tools and frameworks such as Selenium, Junit, Cucumber, Postman, Selenium, TOSCA or similar.
  • Advanced programming skills including automation systems and databases.
  • Familiarity with programming script languages including Java and VBScript.
  • Strong understanding on API Testing, TestNG with Rest Assured/Web Services and SQL dB development experience.
  • Integrate cloud automation solutions into CI/CD pipelines and software delivery processes.
  • Use knowledge of Bunge’s business, structure and strategy to develop innovative solutions to improve results or eliminate problems.
  • Build partnerships, appropriately influence to gain commitment, foster talent and coach others to grow in current or future roles.
  • Drive results through high standards, focus on key priorities, organization, and preparing others for change.

At Bunge (NYSE: BG), our purpose is to connect farmers to consumers to deliver essential food, feed and fuel to the world. As a premier agribusiness solutions provider, our team of ~37,000 dedicated employees partner with farmers across the globe to move agricultural commodities from where they’re grown to where they’re needed—in faster, smarter, and more efficient ways. We are a world leader in grain origination, storage, distribution, oilseed processing and refining, offering a broad portfolio of plant-based oils, fats, and proteins. We work alongside our customers at both ends of the value chain to deliver quality products and develop tailored, innovative solutions that address evolving consumer needs. With 200+ years of experience and presence in over 50 countries, we are committed to strengthening global food security, advancing sustainability, and helping communities prosper where we operate. Bunge has its registered office in Geneva, Switzerland and its corporate headquarters in St. Louis, Missouri. Learn more at Bunge.com.

Every day our people exemplify these values, which represent Bunge at its core:

  • We Are One Team – Collaborative, Respectful, Inclusive
  • We Lead The Way – Agile, Empowered, Innovative
  • We Do What’s Right – Safety, Sustainability, With Integrity

If this sounds like you, join us! We value and invest in people who believe in our purpose and are excited to live it every day – people who are #ProudtoBeBunge.

description:
Title: Resource Manager, Professional Services

Join to apply for the Resource Manager, Professional Services role at CAI Software, LLC.

Business Unit: Graphic Communications Department: Customer & Professional Services Location: Brazil, Remote

Graphic Communications, a CAI Division, is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for the print industry. Graphic Communications' integrated and automated offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With over thirty years dedicated to delivering best‑in‑class technology to the packaging and printing industries, it is the company's deeply held philosophy that they succeed when its customers thrive.

Position Overview

The Resource Manager plays a critical role in ensuring Professional Services teams are properly staffed, aligned, and equipped to meet project timelines and business objectives. This role involves close collaboration with Project Managers, Project Coordinators, Regional Managers, the Sr. Director of Professional Services, Customer Success, and Sales to efficiently manage resources, balance workloads, and ensure smooth project delivery.

Core Responsibilities

Resource Planning and Allocation: Identify, assign, and allocate resources to ongoing and upcoming projects based on skills, availability, and priorities. Maintain a real‑time view of resource capacity and project needs across the organization. Serve as the primary point of contact for project staffing and collaborate with Sales and Regional Managers to ensure proper coverage for upcoming engagements. Own all new engagements at intake and assign resources based on availability and skillset. Check in regularly with Project Managers to confirm they have the resources required for project success. Maintain up‑to‑date skills and certifications records for all consultants.

Forecasting and Talent Management: Collaborate with Sales, Project Managers, Regional Managers, and leadership to forecast future resource requirements. Identify resource gaps and recommend cross‑training, recruitment, or subcontracting needs based on upcoming opportunities. Support long‑term workforce planning and professional development of consultants.

Process Optimization and Tool Management: Develop and maintain tools, dashboards, and reports to monitor utilization, productivity, and performance. Establish and enforce consistent processes for resource requests and assignments to maximize efficiency. Ensure data and processes remain aligned across systems.

Daily Operational Responsibilities: New Engagement Intake: Review new projects pushed from Salesforce into Wrike. Confirm all project metadata (customer, region, product, estimated hours, and key contacts). Confirm the correct Wrike template and folder structure were created. If automation fails, manually create projects using Salesforce data. Assignment & Scheduling: Review unassigned Wrike projects daily. Match consultants to projects based on skill set, availability, and regional needs. Assign both primary and secondary consultants and confirm schedules with stakeholders. Flag any assignment conflicts or delays to Regional Managers or Services Leads.

System Sync and Integration Oversight: Cross‑reference Salesforce data and ensure accurate synchronization between Salesforce, Wrike, NetSuite, and Concur. Validate billing fields (sold‑to ID, billing trigger, engagement type) and confirm correct syncing. Ensure Concur sync processes are updating users, vendors, and expenses accurately. Monitor Wrike integration logs and elevate issues as needed. Maintain field mapping and oversee sync processes across Salesforce, NetSuite, and Concur. Track and resolve open integration issues in collaboration with Operations.

Time Tracking Oversight: Validate daily timesheet entries for all consultants. Identify missing, misallocated, or excessive time entries and follow up as needed. Escalate persistent noncompliance to Regional Managers. Ensure adherence to time entry policies for accurate utilization and billing reporting.

Project Health & Status Monitoring: Monitor project dashboards in Wrike for task completion, budget consumption, and forecasted effort.

Reporting & Communication: Participate in regular syncs with Regional Managers. Track upcoming projects, resourcing constraints, and urgent escalations. Respond to inquiries regarding capacity, project swaps, or timeline adjustments. Provide data for utilization, staffing, revenue forecasting, and any other Professional Services metrics.

Performance and Collaboration: Monitor workload balance across consultants. Participate in resource reviews with Regional Managers to support continuous development based on Sales forecast. Collaborate cross‑functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Professional Services teams to align timelines, priorities, and dependencies.

Qualifications

Experience: 4+ years of experience in resource planning or operations within a software or technology organization. Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and balance resources effectively in a fast‑paced environment.

Skills: Strong proficiency with resource planning tools (e.g., Wrike). Working knowledge of JIRA, Salesforce, and NetSuite preferred. Excellent organizational, communication, and negotiation skills.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Teachable is a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!

What is the role?

We are looking for a senior engineer with backend experience, who will join our team mainly focused on backend development, always focusing on delivering applications for high traffic access, well-monitored and fully tested. You will be responsible for the entire development lifecycle. In our team, everyone has the opportunity to share ideas, bring new solutions, and discuss them with other well-experienced engineers.

In this role you'll :
  • Write secure, efficient, and high-quality code that adheres to best practices, such as encryption of sensitive data and input validation.
  • Develop scalable and reusable code that promotes efficient development, such as creating reusable libraries and components.
  • Identify areas for improvement in the codebase and take ownership of small-to-medium-sized systems, such as fixing bugs and optimizing performance.
  • Quickly understand documentation and utilize testing techniques, such as unit testing, integration testing, and stress testing, to ensure high-quality code.
  • Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders, such as providing regular status updates and actively seeking feedback.
  • Adapt to roadblocks and proactively resolve issues, such as debugging and troubleshooting.
  • Align work with customer value by using feedback to prioritize features.
  • Balance priorities and seek guidance when needed to make informed decisions.
What You’ll Bring :
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building production web applications in an agile, startup environment.
  • Experience migrating domains from monolithic to microservices.
  • Experience working with systems at scale utilizing microservices and AWS services.
  • Interest in learning or exposure to event-based architecture.
  • Team player mentality: high collaborative, documentation-focused and recognizing how to balance asynchronous communications and virtual meetings.
  • A passion for solving complex technical problems in both new and legacy codebases.
  • A mindset of leaving the codebase better than how you found it.
  • Experience collaborating with multiple team members with varying experience levels to design and implement technical projects.
  • Ability to work and problem-solve independently.
  • A humble, collaborative, customer-focused, and highly curious approach to problem-solving.
Nice to have :

Golang experience

This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.

title: Coordenador Administrativo
description:
Desde 1948, a Andrade Gutierrez vem ajudando a construir e a desenvolver o Brasil. Desde então, a empresa tem participado de algumas das obras mais importantes da história de nosso país. Construímos o desenvolvimento de uma sociedade e inovamos todos os dias na forma de pensar e de fazer engenharia.

A Andrade Gutierrez se destaca como uma das maiores empresas de engenharia da América Latina e nossa trajetória tem sido marcada pela busca por novas oportunidades e grandes desafios.

Nosso desenvolvimento acontece de forma sustentável e está apoiado em pilares como qualidade, responsabilidade socioambiental e segurança no trabalho. Nossas unidades de engenharia e construção são focadas em projetos de Infraestrutura, Energia, Mobilidade e Indústria, com ênfase na excelência operacional.

Se você é focado em processos, é flexível e se adapta às mudanças, e anseia por trabalhar em uma multinacional em expansão, aqui é o seu lugar!

Na Andrade Gutierrez todas as pessoas são bem-vindas, independente de gênero, orientação sexual, raça, etnia ou deficiência.

Resumo do Cargo

Profissional será responsável por promover a correta administração contratual, cumprindo todas as obrigações previstas em Contrato, mantendo-se adimplente durante toda a sua execução, acompanhando o Escopo, Custo e Prazo, registrando quaisquer alterações que possam justificar eventuais desvios em relação às condições definidas na contratação (Proposta / Contrato), de forma a minimizar os obstáculos e maximizar as oportunidades, com vista à melhoria constante do desempenho econômico e financeiro do Contrato.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Coordenar e responder por todas as atividades administrativas do canteiro de obras, organizando e orientando os trabalhos específicos da área e controlando o desempenho do pessoal, para assegurar o desenvolvimento normal das rotinas de trabalho.
  • Gestão de Atividades Administrativas;
  • Gerenciar e/ou executar todos os serviços inerentes à área administrativa, financeira e de recursos humanos relacionados à obra;
  • Distribuir os serviços, fornecendo informações e implantando rotinas de trabalho, para assegurar e orientar a sua execução;
  • Organizar as escalas de serviços, de férias e folgas dos funcionários, orientando-se pelas regulamentações pertinentes e por decisões superiores, para atender às determinações legais;
  • Encaminhar pedidos de saídas antecipadas, licenças e afastamentos de seus subordinados, opinando sobre méritos, propondo sanções disciplinares ou recompensas e indicando o possível substituto nos casos de impedimento, para evitar interrupções de trabalho ou anomalias prejudiciais ao rendimento da unidade;
  • Requisitar o pessoal e material necessários ao desempenho dos trabalhos do setor, solicitando o preenchimento de formulários e enviando-os à seção especializada;

  • Acompanhar, avaliar e prover recursos necessários ao treinamento e qualificação individual dos funcionários da obra, verificando as orientações e demonstrações das operações e tarefas a serem executadas, para se obter o rendimento desejado na execução dos trabalhos;
  • Fazer cumprir as normas e ordens de serviço, organizando, distribuindo e orientando os trabalhos a serem executados;
  • Zelar pelo cumprimento dos regulamentos, ordens e instruções de serviços, aplicando as medidas e providências cabíveis, para assegurar a consecução dos objetivos visados;
  • Suporte à Gerência e Diretoria;
  • Prestar as devidas informações relacionadas à administração para o Engenheiro ou Diretor;

  • Mobilizar e desmobilizar a obra em conjunto com o Engenheiro e Diretor de Operações.

title: Coordenador de Engenharia de Software
description:
Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo :

Esta pessoa irá contribuir com os processos de qualidade em tecnologia do Grupo Fleury por meio de técnicas, ferramentas e parceria entre os times de Digital e Tech da empresa. Fazemos uso da tecnologia e inovação para gerar a movimentação que o mercado precisa. Somos reconhecidos pelo nosso propósito : cuidar das pessoas e buscamos aqueles que compartilham desse ideal.

Esta posição serve como uma camada intermediária vital entre o Gerente de Engenharia e os Líderes Técnicos das equipes, garantindo a coesão e a eficiência nas operações de desenvolvimento e entregas. O Tech Coordinator será responsável por equilibrar funções técnicas e de gestão de pessoas, ajudando na estruturação da área e impulsionando a excelência técnica e operacional.

Deseja trabalhar em um lugar que concilie desafio, agilidade e inovação? Aqui é o lugar.

Principais atividades :
  • Apoiar no processo de recrutamento e seleção.
  • Coordenar o onboardingde novos membros.
  • Desenvolver planos de integração de 30, 60 e 90 dias para novos colaboradores.
  • Supervisionar a governança dos repositórios, ferramentas, sistemas internos e de cloud.
  • Implementar e monitorar políticas de segurança da informação / arquitetura.
  • Estabelecer e otimizar processos de deploy.
  • Desenvolver, manter e otimizar pipelines de integração e entrega contínuas (CI / CD)
  • Realizar processos de GMUD para entregas dos times
  • Também tirar impedimentos – sejam eles tech ou não
  • Trocar com outras squads
  • Realizar reuniões regulares de 1 : 1 com membros dos times para feedback e desenvolvimento.
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento profissional e pessoal dos integrantes das equipes.
  • Estabelecer e monitorar alertas e métricas de desempenho dos produtos.
  • Implementar práticas de observabilidadee garantir a saúde dos sistemas.
  • Promover e implementar metodologias ágeis.
  • Aprovar horas de acordo com o realizado do mês.
Buscamos alguém que apresente :
  • Experiência como Líder Técnico ou Coordenador de Tecnologia, gerenciando equipes de desenvolvimento de software
  • Experiência com governança de repositórios, ferramentas de cloud e implementação de políticas de Segurança da Informação, Engenharia de dados.
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, Lean) e práticas de DevOps(CI / CD, pipelines, SQL,). Conhecimento em Dados
  • Familiaridade com processos de GMUD (Gestão de Mudanças em Ambiente de Desenvolvimento) e deploy.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de integração e entrega contínuas (CI / CD), como Jenkins, GitLabCI / CD, CircleCI ou similares.
  • Experiência com cloud computing(AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em versionamento de código (Git) e governança de repositórios.
  • Familiaridade com práticas de observabilidade(monitoramento, logging e alertas).
  • Experiência em garantir a segurança da informação e arquitetura de sistemas.
  • Experiência com coordenação de onboarding e integração de novos colaboradores.
  • Habilidade em realizar reuniões de feedback (1 : 1) e desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Capacidade de remover impedimentos, sejam eles técnicos ou organizacionais, para garantir a fluidez do trabalho das equipes.
  • Facilidade para trabalhar com múltiplas squads, promovendo colaboração entre times.
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade para realizar trocas técnicas com outros times.

Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que :

  • Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;
  • Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;
  • Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;
  • Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;
  • Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;
  • Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.
Informações da vaga :

Modelo de Trabalho (Home Office)

Carga Horária : 220h

Escala : Segunda a Sexta

Horário de Trabalho : 08h00 ás 17h48

Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada!

Saúde e Bem-estar :
  • Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;
  • Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;
  • Linhas de cuidado especializadas : gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras;
  • Acesso à plataforma OrienteMe para sessões de terapia e orientação nutricional;
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas;
  • Acesso ao Wellhub para práticas esportivas e qualidade de vida.
Proteção e estabilidade :
  • Previdência privada;
  • Participação nos lucros;
  • Seguro de vida.
Facilidades para o dia a dia :
  • Vale-Alimentação;
  • Vale-Refeição;
  • Vale-Transporte;
  • Auxílio-Creche;
  • Clube de Descontos com lojas, farmácias, viagem, beleza, cultura, lazer, entre outros serviços.
Desenvolvimento e educação :
  • Plataforma de ensino;
  • Parcerias educacionais com descontos em cursos e instituições.

Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.

Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas.

Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família.

Associate Director Structured Finance: S&P Global Ratings

The Team

When you join S&P Global Ratings you become part of one of the world’s leading providers of independent credit risk research and benchmarks. Ability to prepare forecasts based upon reasoned assumptions.

Advancing Essential Intelligence.

We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. We’re committed to a more equitable future and to helping our customers find new sustainable ways of doing business. Join us and help create the critical insights that truly make a difference.

Our Values

Integrity, Discovery, Partnership

Throughout our history the world’s leading organizations have relied on us for the Essential Intelligence they need to make confident decisions about the road ahead. title: Resource Manager, Professional Services
description:
About Us

Graphic Communications, a CAI Division, is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for the print industry. Graphic Communications' integrated and automated offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With over thirty years dedicated to delivering best‑in‑class technology to the packaging and printing industries, it is the company's deeply held philosophy that they succeed when its customers thrive.

Position Overview

The Resource Manager plays a critical role in ensuring Professional Services teams are properly staffed, aligned, and equipped to meet project timelines and business objectives. This role involves close collaboration with Project Managers, Project Coordinators, Regional Managers, the Senior Director of Professional Services, Customer Success, and Sales to efficiently manage resources, balance workloads, and ensure smooth project delivery.

Core Responsibilities

Resource Planning and Allocation Identify, assign, and allocate resources to ongoing and upcoming projects based on skills, availability, and priorities. Maintain a real‑time view of resource capacity and project needs across the organization. Serve as the primary point of contact for project staffing and collaborate with Sales and Regional Managers to ensure proper coverage for upcoming engagements. Own all new engagements at intake and assign resources based on availability and skillset. Check in regularly with Project Managers to confirm they have the resources required for project success. Maintain up‑to‑date skills and certifications records for all consultants.

Forecasting and Talent Management Collaborate with Sales, Project Managers, Regional Managers, and leadership to forecast future resource requirements. Identify resource gaps and recommend cross‑training, recruitment, or subcontracting needs based on upcoming opportunities. Support long‑term workforce planning and professional development of consultants.

Process Optimization and Tool Management Develop and maintain tools, dashboards, and reports to monitor utilization, productivity, and performance. Establish and enforce consistent processes for resource requests and assignments to maximize efficiency. Ensure data and processes remain aligned across systems.

Daily Operational Responsibilities

New Engagement Intake Review new projects pushed from Salesforce into Wrike. Confirm all project metadata: customer, region, product, estimated hours, and key contacts. Confirm the correct Wrike template and folder structure were created. If automation fails, manually create projects using Salesforce data.

Assignment & Scheduling Review unassigned Wrike projects daily. Match consultants to projects based on skill set, availability, and regional needs. Assign both primary and secondary consultants and confirm schedules with stakeholders. Flag any assignment conflicts or delays to Regional Managers or Services Leads.

System Sync and Integration Oversight Cross‑reference Salesforce‑Wrike and Wrike‑NetSuite mappings to ensure accuracy. Validate billing fields (sold‑to ID, billing trigger, engagement type) and confirm correct syncing. Ensure Concur sync processes are updating users, vendors, and expenses accurately. Monitor Wrike integration logs and elevate issues as needed. Maintain field mapping and oversee sync processes across Salesforce, NetSuite, and Concur. Track and resolve open integration issues in collaboration with Operations.

Time Tracking Oversight Validate daily timesheet entries for all consultants. Identify missing, misallocated, or excessive time entries and follow up as needed. Escalate persistent noncompliance to Regional Managers. Ensure adherence to time entry policies for accurate utilization and billing reporting.

Project Health & Status Monitoring

Monitor project dashboards in Wrike for task completion, budget consumption, and forecasted effort.

Reporting & Communication

Participate in regular syncs with Regional Managers. Track upcoming projects, resourcing constraints, and urgent escalations. Respond to inquiries regarding capacity, project swaps, or timeline adjustments. Provide data for utilization, staffing, revenue forecasting, and any other Professional Services metrics. Monitor workload balance across consultants. Participate in resource reviews with Regional Managers to support continuous development based on Sales forecast. Collaborate cross‑functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Professional Services teams to align timelines, priorities, and dependencies.

Qualifications

Experience: 4+ years of experience in resource planning or operations within a software or technology organization. Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and balance resources effectively in a fast‑paced environment. Skills: Strong proficiency with resource planning tools (e.g., Wrike). Working knowledge of JIRA, Salesforce, and NetSuite preferred. Excellent organizational, communication, and negotiation skills.

title: Software Engineer Iii (Senior)
description:
Software Engineer III

At Komatsu Mining Technology Solutions (MTS), we don't just talk about progress and innovation – we put it into practice. Our cutting‑edge modular solutions are driving operations around the world, promoting efficiency and sustainability at levels that, until recently, seemed impossible. MTS is a global leader in mine management technology and a wholly owned subsidiary of Komatsu Ltd. Our innovative technology powers mining operations in diverse regions around the world. The products we develop, the solutions we design, and the services we provide set us apart in the mining technology industry. We are more than a company: we are a community of passionate and creative professionals united by a common vision – to transform the way the mining industry operates. With a presence that extends from Johannesburg to Vancouver, from Sydney to Lima, you will have the opportunity to be part of a global organization that encourages creativity, promotes innovation, and stimulates big thinking, the exchange of ideas, and the generation of real impact.

Job Purpose

The Autonomous Haulage System (AHS) is a comprehensive fleet management system for mines. The autonomous trucks are centrally controlled through a wireless network that integrates on‑board vehicle controllers, high‑precision global positioning, and obstacle avoidance systems. The AHS Product Development team is responsible for building innovative solutions to unique and challenging autonomous operation problems. Working with our partners around the world, you will help design and support the next generation of mine optimization technologies and build the futures platforms that will drive the changes in the mining industry for generations.

Key Job Responsibilities
  • Lead the design, development, monitoring, and enhancement of services our team provides for Komatsu customers, including machine coordination, equipment management, navigation planning, collision detection, and safeguard management.
  • Work closely with the Product Management team and engage directly with customers to understand needs and clarify product requirements.
  • Apply deep knowledge of software design patterns, scalable cloud architectures, and cloud design best practices.

Mission‑obsessed.

The mental health gap bothers you enough to build the fix.

Owner’s mindset. You grab the problem, simplify, and ship.

Weekly. Resourceful as hell. You bias to MVP, learn in production, and improve fast. Resilient. You want the hard thing because the hard thing matters. Clear, candid communicator. Crisp async writing; short demos; low‑ego reviews.

End‑to‑end product slices that remove friction between someone in crisis and someone who can help. Check really.global to see where we are.

  • Roll out the Hotline

The Deal

Transparent Equity Partnership. Merit‑based ownership. Contribution translates directly to equity from a dedicated 5% contributor pool. Your stake grows with every outcome you ship. Points‑for‑outcomes system. We measure contribution in Story Points, a standard unit of complexity, not hours.

This rewards your efficiency and impact. All work is valued.

You earn points not just for new features but also for essential “glue work” like bug fixes, documentation, and incident response. Real shipped value.

Ownership accrues only when your work is reviewed by a peer, merged, and live in production.

To protect our quality bar, we have a “regression clawback” for code that causes critical bugs. Clear commitment & vesting.

We use a 6‑month active contribution cliff with a minimum monthly point threshold to ensure we’re a great fit. After the cliff, your grant vests over a 3‑year period—quarterly tranches. High‑impact bounties. Mission‑critical milestones (e.g., Talk Now launch) carry outsized point rewards to align effort with key business goals. Locked‑in stake.

When we close our first priced funding round, the program freezes and everyone’s earned percentage becomes a fixed part of our cap table. No hours theater. No politics. Value in production = ownership.

Direct Access

You work directly with US founders. No middle management. No “local office” politics. Human Impact: Your code will literally save lives in 200+ countries, including your own.
